jobs.excerpt: Are you passionate about driving growth in the e-commerce space?
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about driving growth in the e-commerce space? Our client, Tucketts, an innovative US-based socks and foot care brand, is looking for an experienced E-Commerce Growth Marketing Manager to join its team and lead strategic initiatives that will elevate the brand to new heights. This is a fully remote, full-time role.

This role will focus on creating and executing growth strategies across multiple channels, improving the customer journey, and maximizing our brand presence on social media, email, and other key platforms. If you have a deep understanding of the e-commerce landscape, particularly with Shopify, and are data-driven, collaborative, and proactive, with a track record of achieving growth in a fast-paced e-commerce environment, please read on!

About the Company:

Tucketts is a rapidly growing e-commerce brand with a strong presence in the Shopify ecosystem and on Amazon. This women-owned company is dedicated to promoting foot health and wellness through a unique range of socks and foot care products. Tucketts mission is to empower individuals to prioritize their foot health while making a positive social impact through ethical manufacturing practices. The company prioritizes sustainability by creating eco-friendly products and supporting fair labor practices, ensuring a balance between people, profit, and the planet. Tucketts employs women in Colombia, supporting their economic empowerment, and contributes to educational initiatives for girls in the Maasai community in Tanzania, inspired by the founders journey up Mount Kilimanjaro.

Your Goals in This Role:

  • Leverage our customer base to boost sales and expand our social media reach.
  • Develop our Shopify brand through targeted e-commerce promotions, email marketing and digital campaigns
  • Double our sales and customer base.
  • Analyze performance data to continually improve ad spend efficiency and ROI.
  • Enhance our social media presence by growing our TikTok following and engaging with our Instagram influencers, followers, and email list.
  • Manage current team and hire new members according to the company's needs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Devise and implement strategies to achieve ambitious sales targets and customer acquisition goals.
  • Develop and execute digital marketing campaigns, including email marketing, social media, SEO, and PPC, to drive traffic and increase conversions.
  • Continuously analyze and optimize the website for user experience, performance, and conversion rates, implementing A/B testing and analytics to inform decisions.
  • Optimize our social media channels and influencers to amplify brand messaging and drive conversions.
  • Execute compelling e-commerce promotions that resonate with our target audience.
  • Develop and execute effective email marketing campaigns to nurture customer relationships and drive repeat purchases.
  • Manage and optimize advertising campaigns on Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, Pinterest, and other relevant social media platforms.
  • Oversee day-to-day operations of the Tucketts online store, ensuring a seamless shopping experience for customers.
  • Monitor and analyze eCommerce performance metrics, providing insights and recommendations for improvement to achieve sales targets. Use data-driven approaches to make strategic decisions.
  • Find and collaborate with influencers to become brand ambassadors

Requirements:

  • 3+ years in a growth marketing or digital marketing role, within e-commerce.
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing tools and strategies (SEO, PPC, etc).
  • Proficiency in Shopify, email marketing and social media platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience using data to inform marketing strategies.
  • Creativity and innovation in developing engaging marketing campaigns.
  • Knowledge of Amazon specifics is a huge plus.
  • Comfortable with implementing automation tools and exploring AI to improve efficiency.
  • Creative thinker with strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative mindset.
  • A strong desire to grow a company and demonstrate skills that lead to measurable impact.

What We Offer:

  • Remote flexibility and work-life balance.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Collaborative and supportive team culture.
  • Remote flexibility and work-life balance.

jobs.description:
The Manager will report to a Senior Manager, Commercial Servicing Operations and will oversee a team of Asset Managers and Portfolio Managers overseeing Commercial Real Estate (“CRE”) loans. This team will include 3-10 direct reports.The Manager will share responsibility for hiring, training, and evaluating existing team members.Additionally, the Manager will handle escalated items for both Investors and Borrowers and is expected to fully understand day-to-day CRE servicing responsibilities as well as multiple product types of CRE loans, including Commercial Mortgage-Backed Securities (CBMS), debt fund, and Single-Family Residential (SFR) loans.Manager will act as a backup point of contact for other business units at Onity for inter-company projects, system enhancements, and other items as they arise.Manager will monitor reports and team performance to proactively identify portfolio risks, employee training opportunities, and engage with staff to ensure that all reporting metrics, contractual obligations, and covenant monitoring requirements are met. Manager may have a portfolio of loans assigned to them for daily workload.Individuals in this role are required to adhere to investor servicing guidelines, internal policies, and procedures.

Job Responsibilities and Requirements

  • Customer Service and Escalation Management:
    • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex Borrower and Investor matters, managing relationships with Borrowers, Investors, Master Servicers, and third-party stakeholders. Resolve servicing issues, facilitate transactions, and deliver a high level of customer service
    • Partner with Asset Management, Special Servicing, Legal, Compliance, and other internal stakeholders to address portfolio challenges, execute complex transactions, support strategic business objectives, and monitor reporting to ensure team performance meets client and contract expectations
  • Team Building:
    • Lead and support a team of Asset Managers and Portfolio Managers, providing adequate ongoing training, guidance, coaching, and oversight to ensure timely and accurate management of loan servicing activities and Borrower requests
    • Monitor team workflows, staffing levels, and servicing activities to ensure Borrower inquiries, consent requests, reserve disbursements, covenant monitoring, and loan administration tasks are completed within established expectations
    • Provide adequate training and direction to team members
    • Lead team building sessions and ongoing meetings with direct reports and broader team to ensure engagement and issue resolution
  • Portfolio Management:
    • Analyze portfolio trends and servicing metrics to identify risks, opportunities, and operational efficiencies, providing recommendations to senior management as appropriate
    • Drive continuous process improvement initiatives by evaluating current procedures, strengthening controls, and implementing best practices to enhance operational effectiveness and portfolio management outcomes
    • Manage portfolio performance monitoring, including watchlist assets, covenant compliance, maturity exposure, and other risk indicators, while escalating concerns and recommending appropriate action when necessary
    • Facilitate and contribute to monthly Watchlist meetings, ensuring asset-level performance concerns, Borrower challenges, and risk mitigation strategies are clearly communicated and documented
    • Assist with the planning and execution of special projects, system enhancements, process implementations, and other department initiatives
    • Prepare and review management reports, portfolio summaries, and team performance metrics to support business planning, resource allocation, and leadership decision-making
    • Strong knowledge of CRE loan participation and insurance coverage requirements
    • Spread and analyze property level financial statements and provide training to Asset Managers for complex assets
  • Contract Management:
    • Maintain a thorough understanding of servicing agreements, loan documents, cash management structures, and Investor guidelines to support servicing platform and ensure contractual compliance
    • Ability to understand and interpret contractual requirements and to be able to effectively pass knowledge to team members
    • Ensure compliance with all contract terms by both the Servicing Team and other business units within Onity
    • Work with other business units to provide training and support as necessary in order to ensure contract compliance
    • Review reporting to ensure accurate calculations on client reporting to ensure contract compliance
    • Ability to read, interpret, and teach PSA, TSA, SSA, and Servicing Agreements
  • System Management:
    • Ability to effectively communicate reporting needs to other departments in order to enable them to build out various reports to fit client and Onity needs
    • Strong understanding of system and bank accounting structures and cash flow
    • Demonstrated ability to train reports and other business units on intricacies of servicing system
  • Other Responsibilities and Requirements:
    • Adapt quickly to various requests from multiple sources
    • Prioritize multiple, simultaneous incoming requests, all seen as urgent priority
    • Work with internal business units to develop reports for investors as required
    • Coordinate with internal departments for servicing functions as required.
    • Proactively review and update internal policies and procedures as required
    • Assist with audit and rating agency requests and presentations
    • Lead Commercial team trainings
    • Assist in the preparation of presentations for investors, management, and internal business units
    • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Demonstrates positive attitude, adds to a positive team morale, and is eager to take on and learn new things
  • Four year degree from an accredited University preferred or equivalent work experience
  • Minimum of 10 years of CRE loan servicing experience required, 1 – 2 years in a leadership position preferred
  • Full understanding of the full CRE loan life cycle from onboarding through Mortgage Satisfaction.
  • Prior experience with CMBS, RMBS, SFR Portfolio loans, and/or CREFC reporting requirements is a plus
  • High attention to detail
  • Strong proficiency in Word, Excel, Outlook, CoPilot, and other information processing programs
  • Self-motivated and works independently
  • Ability to perform complex calculations using calculators and systems is required
  • Ability to reason and exercise sound judgment
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately

  • Outstanding communications skills (including verbal, written and listening skills), with an emphasis on strong customer service, professional relationship building skills, conflict resolution, and having difficult conversations

  • Previous experience with REALSynergy servicing system is considered a plus

Training / Licensing Requirements:

  • Must pass the Company’s Background Screening process prior to beginning employment. Additionally, as a condition of employment, you may be required to pass client-specific background check requirements or Federal/State licensing requirements, if applicable.

The salary range for this position is expected to be $115,000 to $130,000 per year, depending on geographic location, experience, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for annual bonus of 15% based on performance and subject to the terms of the Company’s applicable plans.

Fyfe's Power & Electrification Division partners with major energy developers and infrastructure clients to deliver large-scale renewable energy and power infrastructure projects across Australia. As a Senior Electrical Designer, you will play a key role in the design and delivery of Electrical Balance of Plant (EBOP) projects for wind farms, solar farms and BESS developments, while also supporting HV transmission and distribution infrastructure. You will collaborate virtually with experienced engineers and designers across Australia and the Philippines, gaining exposure to a broad range of technical disciplines and some of Australia's most significant energy projects.

This permanent work-from-home role offers exposure to HV substations, switchyards, underground and overhead reticulation systems, grid connection infrastructure and utility coordination activities. You will contribute to complex technical projects in a supportive team environment, with regular online collaboration across locations and time zones.

Please note: This position is open to candidates residing in the Philippines. The successful candidate will be employed locally through a third-party employment agency and will work exclusively with Fyfe's Power & Electrification Division.

The Impact You'll Have

  • Deliver high-quality electrical design documentation for HV substations, utility infrastructure and renewable energy projects.
  • Develop primary design deliverables including equipment layouts, cable routing, earthing systems, conduit layouts and detailed construction drawings.
  • Support the successful coordination and delivery of multidisciplinary design packages to meet project and client requirements.
  • Contribute to HV and LV power system designs, equipment selection and technical solutions for complex energy infrastructure projects.
  • Collaborate with engineers and project teams to enhance design quality, project delivery and technical outcomes.
  • Help shape the delivery of renewable energy, transmission and power infrastructure projects that support Australia's evolving energy sector.

What You'll Bring

We are looking for an experienced Senior Electrical Designer based in the Philippines who is comfortable working remotely with Australian project teams, solving complex technical challenges and delivering high-quality outcomes across a diverse portfolio.

  • A bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline from a recognised institution.
  • 8+ years' experience within a design consultancy environment.
  • Strong experience in HV substation design and detailed design delivery using MicroStation and AutoCAD.

  • Strong written and verbal English communication, organisational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote, cross-border team.
  • Previous experience supporting Australian projects or working to Australian Standards is highly regarded.

It would be great if you also have experience in High Voltage and Low Voltage Switchboard design in accordance with AS 61439 and exposure to instrumentation and control systems.

Why Fyfe?

Engagement type: Independent consultant, 1099 hourly.
Rate range: $100 - $500 per hour, based on experience and scope (three-tier band detailed below).
Time commitment: Part-time or fractional, scales with pipeline (typically 10-40 hrs/week).
Location: Remote with quarterly DC travel preferred.
Reports to: GovCon Division Lead.

A note from the founder

TWF has built the scaffolding for federal work. MBE certification, SAM.gov registration, two operational divisions ready to serve federal contracts, a credentialed bench, and signed commercial customers proving the operating model. What is missing is the capture function. This engagement is for the operator who knows how to walk a federal opportunity from first signal through awarded contract, and who wants to build that function inside a firm where it does not exist yet.

What is already built

The Wilkinson Firm is a workforce strategy and staffing firm headquartered across NC and Atlanta. We launched in April 2025 and are now in Year 2 of operations. Two operational divisions today (HR Advisory for the mental health industry, Premium Hospitality and Event Staffing). Government Contracting division being formally stood up this quarter. Three active staffing contracts in delivery. FY26 trajectory $425-525K. Zero loans, zero institutional debt. Defined path to $5M+ over the next 24 months.

Federal-relevant scaffolding:[- Two operational divisions ready to serve federal contracts in HHS-adjacent verticals (VA mental health programs, DoD behavioral health support, HHS workforce IDIQs) and hospitality (federal lodging, on-base food service, training facility F&B).

What you own

  • Federal opportunity identification and qualification across SAM.gov, GSA Schedules, agency forecasts, and prime/sub channels
  • Capture-to-proposal lifecycle: opportunity assessment, teaming strategy, technical and price strategy, color-team reviews, submission readiness
  • Capture playbook documentation: pursuit criteria, gate reviews, win themes, ghosting strategy, competitive analysis
  • Prime and sub partner relationships and government POC management
  • Set-aside strategy and certification work (8(a), HUBZone, WOSB, SDVOSB) in coordination with the GovCon Division Lead
  • Pipeline visibility and reporting to firm leadership
  • Coaching the Proposal Manager and Federal Account Executive seats as they come online

Engagement structure

Hourly consulting rate, three tiers calibrated to experience and scope:

  • Foundational ($100-200/hr): Capture managers with 5-8 years experience, ramping into a director role
  • Director ($200-350/hr): Established capture directors with documented win history on $1M+ contracts
  • Principal ($350-500/hr): Senior capture principals with multi-million-dollar award history and Tier 1 prime experience

Engagement is hourly. Time commitment scales with pipeline activity, typically 10-40 hours per week. Win-based bonus stack negotiable on top of hourly rate for awarded contracts the engagement materially drove.

Success milestones

  • Day 30: Capture playbook drafted. Pursuit gate criteria documented. Initial pipeline of 10+ qualified opportunities.
  • Day 90: 2-4 active captures in formal pursuit. First teaming agreements signed. Pipeline value $1M+.
  • Day 180: 2-4 proposals submitted. First award or shortlist position. Win rate baseline established.

Who you are

  • 7-15 years in federal capture, proposal management, or BD for small to mid-size GovCon firms
  • Documented track record capturing $1M+ federal contracts
  • Shipley-trained or equivalent. SAM.gov fluent. Comfortable with FAR/DFARS terminology
  • Familiar with small business set-asides and the certification lifecycle
  • Past performance citations in workforce, HHS-adjacent, hospitality, or staffing services preferred
  • Comfortable building a function from scratch inside a founder-led firm
  • Located in DC, NC, GA, or willing to travel to DC quarterly

Bonus points

  • Prior role at a Tier 1 GovCon prime or boutique capture firm
  • Existing relationships at DoD, VA, HHS, GSA, or DHS
  • APMP credential
  • Track record of managed HUBZone or 8(a) certifications

How we will get to know each other

  1. Initial 30-minute fit conversation with the GovCon Division Lead
  2. Working session: walk through a real federal opportunity or proposal scenario we are actively considering
  3. Reference checks (3+ professional references) and work history verification
  4. Engagement letter, scope of work, and rate confirmation
  5. Kickoff within 7 days of signed engagement

2-4 weeks first conversation to active engagement.

What we believe

Trust before revenue. Mission before money. Real seats, real upside. We build durable federal relationships through earned credibility. We win together. We pay people in real numbers, not pizza parties. We are building something great and we want partners who feel the same.

Application tips

  1. Visit , ,
  2. Find The Wilkinson Firm on LinkedIn
  3. In your cover note, answer two questions: (1) what kind of GovCon engagement model works best for you (project-based, retained hours, hybrid), and (2) one example of a federal pursuit, proposal, or account you would point to as your strongest reference work

What to expect from us

  • Reply within 48 hours
  • First-round conversation within 7 days of qualification
  • Full process: 2-4 weeks
  • We tell you yes or no. We do not ghost.

For candidates able to start before December 2026, a discretionary sign‑on bonus of up to 4,300 EUR may be offered, with the final amount confirmed at offer stage, subject to role level and relevant experience.


IQVIA™ is the leading human data science company focused on helping healthcare clients find unparalleled insights and better solutions for patients.

Formed through the merger of IMS Health and Quintiles, IQVIA offers a broad range of solutions that harness the power of healthcare data, domain expertise, transformative technology, and advanced analytics to drive healthcare forward.


Within our Sponsor dedicated model, our team contributes to the pipelines of the specific sponsor and therefore our CRAs are ‘indication and molecule experts’. We set ourselves apart with collaboration and face to face contact both at start up and during the clinical study.


Leadership recognises the skills, talent and experience of our clinical teams and strives to build upon this as the function evolves and grows. Our managers understand the sponsors priorities and the individual aspects of each model. Focus is given to career development from day one, including new hire orientation and onboarding, day to day problem solving and training and development.


Additionally, IQVIA’s sponsor dedicated business works with the Sponsors SOP’s, creating more continuity for both parties.


Our models offer excellent opportunities for experienced CRA’s to expand their knowledge and skills.


IQVIA Belgium are currently seeking motivated Senior Clinical Research Associate practitioner to join our unique and dynamic Sponsor dedicated model.

This is a role based in Belgium


Your Role:

  • Perform site monitoring visits (selection, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits) in accordance with contracted scope of work and regulatory requirements, i.e., Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines
  • Work with sites to adapt, drive, and track subject recruitment plan in line with project needs to enhance predictability.
  • Administer protocol and related study training to assigned sites and establish regular lines of communication with sites to manage ongoing project expectations and issues.
  • Evaluate the quality and integrity of study site practices related to the proper conduct of the protocol and adherence to applicable regulations. Escalate quality issues as appropriate.
  • Manage the progress of assigned studies by tracking regulatory submissions and approvals, recruitment and enrollment, case report form (CRF) completion and submission, and data query generation and resolution. May support start-up phase.
  • Ensure copies/originals (as required) site documents are available for filing in the Trial Master File (TMF) and verify that the Investigator's Site File (ISF) is maintained in accordance with GCP and local regulatory requirements.
  • Create and maintain appropriate documentation regarding site management, monitoring visit findings and action plans by submitting regular visit reports, generating follow-up letters and other required study documentation.
  • Collaborate and liaise with study team members for project execution support as appropriate.
  • If applicable, may be accountable for supporting development of project subject recruitment plan on a per site basis.

Your Profile:

  • University degree in scientific discipline or health care
  • Minimum of 3 years of independent, on-site monitoring experience as a CRA within a CRO or pharmaceutical environment.
  • Excellent communication skills in Dutch, French, and English, both written and spoken.
  • Good knowledge of, and skill in applying, applicable clinical research regulatory requirements (i.e., Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines). Organizational and problem-solving skills.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and cross-cultural communication skills to build strong, trusted partnerships with Belgium site investigators and medical staff.
  • A collaborative mindset to work effectively with cross-functional global teams, project managers, and local study coordinators.

Why join us?

  • Grow your career with access to development resources, training, and advancement opportunities
  • Enjoy the flexibility and trust to balance your professional and personal commitments
  • Expand your therapeutic knowledge through dedicated learning and development programs
  • Be part of a successful global organization with an excellent reputation and supportive culture
  • Benefit from a company car, mobile phone, and an attractive rewards and benefits package

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

Our client is a Singapore-based fintech group with regional hubs in Lithuania and Dubai, and operations in Thailand, Indonesia, and the Philippines. Via their flagship product, they offer a cross-border payment solution infrastructure for money transfer operators, local banks, and corporates. With their mobile application, their retail customers and SMEs across Southeast Asia can send money to their families, friends, and business partners around the world.

﻿

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced and results-oriented Senior Director of Sales to lead our client’s global sales strategy within the Money Transfer Operator (MTO) and Payment Service Provider (PSP) sectors. This critical leadership role will be responsible for driving significant revenue growth, managing their global sales team, and expanding their footprint into key international markets. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of the MTO/PSP landscape, a proven track record of exceeding sales targets, and an extensive network within major banks, MTOs, and payment service providers.

Job Type: Full Time

Workplace: Remote

Requirements

  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive sales leadership experience, with a significant focus on the Money Transfer Operator (MTO) and/or Payment Service Provider (PSP) sectors.
  • Demonstrated experience with major banks, MTOs (e.g., Western Union, MoneyGram, Ria), and prominent payment service providers is essential.
  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding sales quotas and driving substantial revenue growth in complex, global environments.
  • Extensive and verifiable network of relationships with key decision-makers and influencers within the MTO and PSP industries.
  • Deep understanding of the global payments landscape, including regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and technological trends (e.g., real-time payments, blockchain, open banking).
  • Exceptional leadership and team management skills, with the ability to inspire, motivate, and develop a high-performing sales force across diverse geographies.
  • Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent negotiation, communication (written and verbal), and presentation skills.

Responsibilities

  • Strategic Sales Leadership: Develop, implement, and refine comprehensive global sales strategies for the MTO and PSP segments to achieve ambitious revenue targets and market share growth.
  • Revenue Management: Own the global MTO/PSP revenue pipeline, forecasting, and P&L. Implement effective pricing strategies and negotiate high-value contracts to maximize profitability.
  • Global Market Expansion: Identify and prioritize new market opportunities within the MTO and PSP ecosystems. Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for international expansion.
  • Team Leadership & Development: Recruit, mentor, and lead a high-performing global sales team. Foster a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement. Provide ongoing coaching, performance management, and career development opportunities.
  • Client Relationship Management: Cultivate and maintain strong, strategic relationships with key decision-makers within major banks, MTOs, and PSPs globally. Act as a trusted advisor and thought leader in the industry.
  • Partnership Development: Identify, evaluate, and forge strategic partnerships that accelerate market penetration and enhance our product/service offerings.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay abreast of industry trends, competitive landscape, regulatory changes, and technological advancements within the MTO and PSP space to inform sales strategies and product development.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product, marketing, operations, and legal teams to ensure alignment of sales strategies with overall business objectives and to effectively bring new solutions to market.
  • Reporting & Analysis: Provide regular, insightful reports on sales performance, market trends, and pipeline status to senior leadership. Utilize data to drive informed decision-making.

Cedars-Sinai offers scientists unparalleled access to ground breaking technologies, facilities, and resources for conducting research related to an impressive range of diseases and disorders, from cancer, cardiology, and digestive diseases, to genetics, genomics, neurosciences, and women's health.

Dr. Bahareh Ajami invites you to consider this Project Scientist opportunity to join her dynamic team!

About the Team

The Ajami Lab is establishing a new research program at Cedars-Sinai focused on immune mechanisms driving neurodegeneration, with a particular emphasis on ALS and microglial biology.

About the Role

The Project Scientist works independently and in cooperation with the Principal Investigator to make significant and creative contributions to a research or creative project in any academic discipline. The Project Scientist may be an ongoing member of a research team or may be employed for a limited period of time to contribute high-level skills to a specific research or creative program. Project Scientists are not required to carry out independent research or to develop an independent research reputation and do not have teaching responsibilities. Ordinarily, the Project Scientist title will carry out research or creative programs as well as administration of day-to-day lab operations with supervision by a member of the Professorial Series.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

jobs.excerpt: OverviewEmpower AI is AI for government.  Empower AI gives federal agency leaders the tools to elevate the potential of their workforce with a direct path for meaningful transformation.
jobs.description:
Overview

Empower AI is AI for government. Empower AI gives federal agency leaders the tools to elevate the potential of their workforce with a direct path for meaningful transformation. Headquartered in Reston, Va., Empower AI leverages three decades of experience solving complex challenges in Health, Defense, and Civilian missions. Our proven Empower AI Platform® provides a practical, sustainable path for clients to achieve transformation that is true to who they are, what they do, how they work, with the resources they have. The result is a government workforce that is exponentially more creative and productive. For more information, visit www.Empower.ai.

Empower AI is proud to be recognized as a 2024 Military Friendly Employer by Viqtory, the publisher of G.I. Jobs. This designation reflects the company’s commitment to hiring and supporting active-duty and veteran employees.

Responsibilities

Description

Empower AI is seeking a motivated Knowledge Center Tier I Agent (Junior) to analyze and resolve support requests from the external industry partners and users of a Department of War agency on its portfolio of mission applications (e.g., DISS, NISS, NBIS). External users reach the Knowledge Center by toll-free phone, support email, public web form, and public chatbot; the agent determines what the user needs and how urgent it is, creates and manages the ticket on the user's behalf, resolves common account, access, and navigation issues using documented procedures, and decides when to escalate. Every ticket follows the email-based Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process. This is a primarily remote position and an excellent entry point into Federal IT customer support. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers.

THIS IS A REMOTE ROLE WITH UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED.

JOB DUTIES:

  • Analyze inbound external-user requests from the toll-free line, support email, public web form, and chatbot handoffs to determine the application, nature, business impact, and Priority Level, and create complete, accurate tickets in the Government's ITSM system on the user's behalf.
  • Determine the resolution approach for common Tier I external-user issues on DISS, NISS, NBIS, and other designated applications using knowledge articles and documented procedures, and decide when escalation to the KC Escalation Coordinator is required.
  • Manage external-user communication through the email-based Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process and safeguard sensitive user information in accordance with Privacy Act and CUI requirements.
  • Analyze incoming incidents and service requests from internal users across phone, chat, email, and portal channels to determine the nature, scope, and business impact of each issue, and independently assign the appropriate Priority Level (PL1 through PL4) and category in the enterprise ITSM platform (e.g., ServiceNow).
  • Determine the appropriate resolution approach for each Tier I issue by evaluating symptoms against known errors, knowledge articles, and system behavior, and decide when an issue can be resolved at Tier I, deflected to self-service, or must be escalated to Tier II, Tier III, or a specialized resolver group.
  • Resolve account, access, connectivity, and application issues by selecting and applying the correct diagnostic and remediation steps, including administrative actions on user accounts and configurations within delegated authority.
  • Evaluate whether resolution actions have fully addressed the customer's need before placing tickets in "Resolved - Awaiting Customer Confirmation" status under the Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process, and document resolutions clearly for reuse by other analysts.
  • Assess the age and risk of items in the open ticket queue, decide which require follow-up with users or resolver groups, and take action to prevent tickets from breaching resolution SLAs.

Qualifications

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor's degree and 0 years of related experience (an Associate's degree with 2 years of related experience, or 4 years of related experience in lieu of a degree, may be substituted).
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.
  • Must have an Active Secret Clearance (favorably adjudicated T3/T3R) to start.
  • Must be willing and able to obtain TS/SCI eligibility after start, if required by mission needs.
  • Must be within investigation scope and/or currently enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting.
  • Must possess and maintain a current DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level I baseline certification (e.g., CompTIA A+ CE, Network+ CE, Security+ CE, CCNA-Security, or SSCP) prior to performing cybersecurity-related duties.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment with limited day-to-day supervision.
  • Experience or demonstrated aptitude in help desk, service desk, call center, desktop support, or customer technical support.
  • Working knowledge of Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365 applications, Active Directory account concepts, basic networking (Wi-Fi, VPN, IP connectivity), and common peripherals.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems and service desk workflows, including accurate ticket documentation and escalation.
  • Ability to work assigned shifts within a 6:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET core schedule, and willingness to work extended-hours shifts (evenings, overnight, weekends, and holidays) if assigned to the extended-hours team.

jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

CrowdStrike Falcon Host is a two-component security product. One component is a “sensor”: a driver installed on client machines that observes system activity and recognizes malicious behavior, then provides on-box prevention capability and remote telemetry to the Falcon Host cloud. The sensor processes thousands of events per second to provide deep visibility into operations on the endpoint, and performs rich correlation and computation to identify malicious events and blocks malicious activity.

The cloud component aggregates sensor telemetry for each customer’s network, correlates malicious behavior across multiple machines, and presents our customers’ operations teams with a prioritized summary of the threats detected in their environments.


This is a Senior Software Development Engineer (SDE) role in the CTIO team that delivers the cutting edge innovation for our sensor (lightweight agent) for Linux, Windows, and Mac OS platforms. The SDE’s in the team own design and development of core features on the platform. Features will cross-cut most core OS subsystems such as file system, memory, process, and networking. Many features are also built in a way that they will have shared components across Linux, Windows, and MacOS. The team operates under the Agile development principles and ships frequently.


The CTIO team at CrowdStrike is responsible for defining and executing the company's technology vision and strategy, driving innovation and overseeing the development and evolution of the Falcon platform. The CTIO ensures CrowdStrike maintains its position as a technology leader by fostering engineering excellence, aligning technical capabilities with business objectives, and anticipating emerging threats and market trends.


What You’ll Do:

  • Collaborate with all the sensor development teams, across the company, on architecture and strategic initiatives.
  • Conceptualize and develop new product features.
  • Provide guidance and support to development teams in designing and implementing software for cross-platform delivery (Windows, macOS, Linux).
  • Take ownership of features throughout the entire lifecycle, from initial design to final delivery, including presenting product demonstrations at the conclusion of each sprint.
  • Engage in cross-functional collaboration with teams situated in various locations.

What You’ll Need:

  • Deep knowledge of C/C++.
  • Extensive understanding of Linux OS internals.

  • Establish and enforce a modern Salesforce DevOps practice, including source-driven development, version control (Git), automated CI/CD pipelines, sandbox seeding/refresh strategy, and environment management aligned to VA release governance.

  • Capture and document requirements for new features, enhancements, and full release packages spanning configuration, development, integration, quality assurance, and test automation.
  • Guide the team's adoption of Agentforce and AI-driven capabilities—designing agent topics, actions, and guardrails, and grounding agents in trusted VA data—while ensuring alignment with federal AI, privacy, and security policy.
  • Serve as the technical escalation point and mentor for developers and admins, conducting design and code reviews and upholding platform health, technical debt reduction, and org governance.

Additional responsibilities may include:

  • Establish the detailed system architecture, including system schematics, performance-based descriptions of systems and subsystems, and the key interfaces between them.
  • Support VA future-state planning alongside the VA Project Team and VA support organizations; map current business processes to out-of-the-box SaaS/PaaS capabilities to maximize configuration and minimize custom development.
  • Document the object/data model, including all relationships across existing and new objects, and maintain it as a living architectural artifact.
  • Produce the CRUD (create, read, update, delete) matrix for each object and field across all user personas, along with record- and field-level security requirements.

  • Design and document integration patterns (REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, MuleSoft or equivalent middleware) connecting Salesforce to VA systems of record and external services.
  • Document exception approvals for any customization—including Apex, custom UI, and new profiles/permission sets—consistent with VA Development Standards, and drive the team toward permission-set-based access models.

  • BS/BA with 12 years of experience, Master's with 10 years, or PhD with 7.

  • Ability to Obtain and Maintain a Public Trust clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.description:
Job Summary

Job Summary:

Location: 100% remote (US only), supporting VA medical centers in VISN 7 Term: 12-month base period plus four 12-month option periods. Pay: 25.00/hr-30.00/hr

About the role

Aptive Resources is looking for experienced coding auditors to run external coding audits for Veterans Affairs medical centers in Georgia, Alabama, and South Carolina. You'll audit inpatient DRG, outpatient, and professional fee coding, report what you find, and teach VA coding staff and clinicians how to improve. The VA expects about 5,000 audited records a year across the Atlanta, Birmingham, Columbia, and Augusta facilities.

Primary Responsibilities

What you'll do

  • Audit coded data for accuracy and compliance, separately from the regular coding work. Each audit focuses on one area: inpatient facility (DRG), outpatient facility, inpatient professional services including surgery, or outpatient services (urgent care, clinic visits, and ambulatory surgery).
  • Review up to the first 25 diagnoses and the first 25 procedures on each record, for both facility and professional services.
  • Help build statistically valid samples (a 95% confidence level, and at least 10% of records) and data collection tools for each audit.
  • Review each facility's HIMS policies and coding procedures before the audit starts.
  • Classify errors as coding, diagnosis, modifier, documentation, or compliance errors, and back up each one with coding references.
  • Write facility audit reports covering accuracy, financial impact, and areas of concern, and contribute to a network-wide report.
  • Go over draft findings with the HIMS Chief, COR, and facility leaders within 7 business days of the audit, and deliver final reports within 15 business days.
  • Create facility-specific training plans, and lead "train the trainer" education sessions of at least 2 hours, using real charts, for coding staff, managers, and physicians.
  • Run exit conferences with Health Information Management leadership.

Minimum Qualifications

Required qualifications

  • An active RHIA, RHIT, CCS, CCS-P, CPC, or CPC-H credential.
  • At least 3 years of experience as a consultant reviewing records for large tertiary care hospitals and outpatient organizations that cover all subspecialties and primary care.
  • At least 3 years of education and training experience, such as teaching coders or providers.
  • At least 3 years of coding experience.
  • Two current client references who can speak to your audit work. These are submitted with the contract proposal.
  • Proof of active credentials, plus a current resume for the proposal.
  • Completion of an accredited coding, HIM, or health information technician program.
  • Expertise in ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT, HCPCS, DRG/MS-DRG, APC, E/M, and NCCI edits.
  • US citizenship, and the ability to pass a federal background investigation (NACI) and fingerprinting.

Preferred qualifications

  • An auditing credential such as CDIP, CPMA, or CIC, in addition to a required credential.
  • Experience auditing for the VA or another federal health system.
  • Strong report writing and presentation skills, including explaining findings in plain language for non-coders.

Additional requirements

  • Complete the VA's annual Privacy and Information Security Awareness and HIPAA training (TMS 10176 and 10203).
  • Travel to VA facilities only when the government authorizes it. Approved travel is reimbursed under federal travel regulations.

About Aptive

Arrow ARC supports Veterans Health Administration facilities and offices across the U.S. with health care staffing and program support via the 10-year Integrated Critical Staffing Program (ICSP). We provide staffing solutions to address critical shortages in VHA medical facilities caused by turnover, recruitment issues, seasonal needs, surges or emergencies.

Arrow is a certified Service-Disabled, Veteran-Owned Small Business joint venture between Artemis ARC and Aptive Resources, two award-winning companies that share an agile, mission-focused, results driven approach in the federal sector.​ Arrow provides management consulting services and specializes in working with federal government agencies like the Department of Veterans Affairs and Office of Personnel Management.​

EEO Statement

Aptive is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, parental status, veteran status, age, disability, or any other protected class.

Veterans, members of the Reserve and National Guard, and transitioning active-duty service members are highly encouraged to apply.

Rate range: $100 - $500 per hour, based on experience and scope (three-tier band detailed below).

Location: Fully remote.
Reports to: GovCon Division Lead, with dotted line to the Federal Capture Director.

A note from the founder

A great proposal is the difference between a captured opportunity and an awarded contract. We have the capture motion ramping up. We need the operator who turns the captured opportunity into a compliant, compelling, on-time response, and who builds the response library so every future proposal moves faster than the last.

What is already built

The Wilkinson Firm is a workforce strategy and staffing firm headquartered across NC and Atlanta. We launched in April 2025 and are now in Year 2 of operations. Two operational divisions today (HR Advisory for the mental health industry, Premium Hospitality and Event Staffing). Government Contracting division being formally stood up this quarter. Three active staffing contracts in delivery. FY26 trajectory $425-525K. Zero loans, zero institutional debt.

Bench credentials: Former EEOC Administrative Law Judge, employment attorneys (JD, MBA), clinical advisors, 32-year enterprise operations specialist. 47 combined years HHS experience.

What you own

  • Full proposal lifecycle: kickoff, compliance matrix, schedule, color-team reviews (pink, red, gold), production, submission
  • Technical writing and editing across executive summary, technical approach, management approach, past performance, and resumes of key personnel
  • Compliance matrix ownership: every shall, every Section L and M requirement, every page count, every font and margin spec
  • Response library build: past performance citations, key personnel resumes, technical narratives, reusable management approach modules, pricing structures
  • Coordination with the Federal Capture Director on win themes, discriminators, and ghosting strategy
  • Coordination with subcontractor partners on teaming inputs and price submissions
  • Post-submission tracking, debrief capture, and lessons-learned documentation

Engagement structure

Hourly consulting rate, three tiers calibrated to experience and scope:

  • Writer ($100-175/hr): Proposal writers and coordinators with 3-7 years federal proposal experience
  • Manager ($175-325/hr): Proposal managers with documented win history and full-lifecycle ownership
  • Principal ($325-500/hr): Senior proposal directors with multi-million-dollar award history and Tier 1 prime experience

Engagement is hourly. Per-proposal scope and budget defined at proposal kickoff. Win-based bonus stack negotiable on top of hourly rate for proposals that result in awarded contracts.

Success milestones

  • First 60 days: Proposal process documented. Compliance matrix template built. Response library framework established with 5+ reusable past performance citations.
  • First 120 days: First 1-2 proposals submitted on time, compliant, and competitive. Color-team review cadence established.
  • First 180 days: 3-5 proposals submitted. First award or shortlist position. Response library covers 80% of TWF's standard content needs.

Who you are

  • 5-15 years in federal proposal management, technical writing, or capture support
  • Documented track record managing $1M+ federal proposals through full lifecycle to submission
  • Shipley-trained or equivalent. APMP credential preferred
  • Fluent in FAR/DFARS, RFP structure (Sections L and M), and compliance matrix methodology
  • Strong writing voice: clear, persuasive, and adaptable across technical and management content
  • Comfortable working both as lead writer and as orchestrator of subject matter expert input
  • Past performance citations in workforce services, HHS programs, hospitality contracting, or staffing IDIQs preferred
  • Located anywhere in the US

Bonus points

  • Prior role at a Tier 1 GovCon prime or boutique proposal shop
  • Experience with VA, HHS, DoD behavioral health, or federal hospitality contracts
  • Pricing strategy fluency (cost narrative, BOEs, indirect rate structures)
  • Experience standing up a proposal function inside an emerging GovCon firm

How we will get to know each other

  1. Initial 30-minute fit conversation with the GovCon Division Lead
  2. Working session: walk through a real proposal scenario we are actively considering or recently submitted
  3. Reference checks (3+ professional references) and work history verification
  4. Engagement letter, scope of work, and rate confirmation
  5. Kickoff within 7 days of signed engagement

What we believe

Trust before revenue. Mission before money. Real seats, real upside. We build durable federal relationships through earned credibility. We win together. We pay people in real numbers, not pizza parties.

Application tips

  1. Visit , ,
  2. Find The Wilkinson Firm on LinkedIn
  3. In your cover note, answer two questions: (1) what's the engagement shape that works best for you (project-based, retained hours, hybrid), and (2) one example of a federal proposal you would point to as your strongest reference work

What to expect from us

  • Reply within 48 hours
  • First-round conversation within 7 days of qualification
  • Full process: 2-4 weeks
  • We tell you yes or no. We do not ghost.

Engagement type: Independent consultant, 1099 hourly.

A note from the founder

TWF has built the scaffolding for federal work. MBE certification, SAM.gov registration, two operational divisions ready to serve federal contracts, a credentialed bench, and signed commercial customers proving the operating model. What is missing is the capture function. This engagement is for the operator who knows how to walk a federal opportunity from first signal through awarded contract, and who wants to build that function inside a firm where it does not exist yet.

What is already built

The Wilkinson Firm is a workforce strategy and staffing firm headquartered across NC and Atlanta. We launched in April 2025 and are now in Year 2 of operations. Two operational divisions today (HR Advisory for the mental health industry, Premium Hospitality and Event Staffing). Government Contracting division being formally stood up this quarter. Three active staffing contracts in delivery. FY26 trajectory $425-525K. Zero loans, zero institutional debt. Defined path to $5M+ over the next 24 months.

Federal-relevant scaffolding:[- Two operational divisions ready to serve federal contracts in HHS-adjacent verticals (VA mental health programs, DoD behavioral health support, HHS workforce IDIQs) and hospitality (federal lodging, on-base food service, training facility F&B).

What you own

  • Federal opportunity identification and qualification across SAM.gov, GSA Schedules, agency forecasts, and prime/sub channels
  • Capture-to-proposal lifecycle: opportunity assessment, teaming strategy, technical and price strategy, color-team reviews, submission readiness
  • Capture playbook documentation: pursuit criteria, gate reviews, win themes, ghosting strategy, competitive analysis
  • Prime and sub partner relationships and government POC management
  • Set-aside strategy and certification work (8(a), HUBZone, WOSB, SDVOSB) in coordination with the GovCon Division Lead
  • Pipeline visibility and reporting to firm leadership
  • Coaching the Proposal Manager and Federal Account Executive seats as they come online

Engagement structure

Hourly consulting rate, three tiers calibrated to experience and scope:

  • Foundational ($100-200/hr): Capture managers with 5-8 years experience, ramping into a director role
  • Director ($200-350/hr): Established capture directors with documented win history on $1M+ contracts
  • Principal ($350-500/hr): Senior capture principals with multi-million-dollar award history and Tier 1 prime experience

Engagement is hourly. Time commitment scales with pipeline activity, typically 10-40 hours per week. Win-based bonus stack negotiable on top of hourly rate for awarded contracts the engagement materially drove.

Success milestones

  • Day 30: Capture playbook drafted. Pursuit gate criteria documented. Initial pipeline of 10+ qualified opportunities.
  • Day 90: 2-4 active captures in formal pursuit. First teaming agreements signed. Pipeline value $1M+.
  • Day 180: 2-4 proposals submitted. First award or shortlist position. Win rate baseline established.

Who you are

  • 7-15 years in federal capture, proposal management, or BD for small to mid-size GovCon firms
  • Documented track record capturing $1M+ federal contracts
  • Shipley-trained or equivalent. SAM.gov fluent. Comfortable with FAR/DFARS terminology
  • Familiar with small business set-asides and the certification lifecycle
  • Past performance citations in workforce, HHS-adjacent, hospitality, or staffing services preferred
  • Comfortable building a function from scratch inside a founder-led firm
  • Located in DC, NC, GA, or willing to travel to DC quarterly

Bonus points

  • Prior role at a Tier 1 GovCon prime or boutique capture firm
  • Existing relationships at DoD, VA, HHS, GSA, or DHS
  • APMP credential
  • Track record of managed HUBZone or 8(a) certifications

How we will get to know each other

  1. Initial 30-minute fit conversation with the GovCon Division Lead
  2. Working session: walk through a real federal opportunity or proposal scenario we are actively considering
  3. Reference checks (3+ professional references) and work history verification
  4. Engagement letter, scope of work, and rate confirmation
  5. Kickoff within 7 days of signed engagement

2-4 weeks first conversation to active engagement.

What we believe

Trust before revenue. Mission before money. Real seats, real upside. We build durable federal relationships through earned credibility. We win together. We pay people in real numbers, not pizza parties. We are building something great and we want partners who feel the same.

What to expect from us

jobs.excerpt: About Argano Argano is a global specialist consultancy and the High-Performance Operations partner to mid-market and large enterprises.
jobs.description:
About Argano

Argano is a global specialist consultancy and the High-Performance Operations partner to mid-market and large enterprises. We combine deep, practitioner-level industry expertise with connected capability across the platforms that run modern operations — Oracle, SAP, Microsoft, Salesforce, Workday, UKG, Anaplan, Blue Yonder, Databricks and more — to help clients turn technology, data, and AI into measurable operational results. Clients choose Argano for boutique-quality delivery at enterprise scale: the business-problem-first thinking of a specialist with the breadth and reliability to execute across a heterogeneous technology estate.

The Opportunity

Industry analysts shape how buyers, publishers, and private-equity sponsors perceive the services market. As Argano moves from a collection of acquired practices into one unified operating model, we need a single, credible owner of our relationships with Gartner, Forrester, IDC, Everest Group, HFS, ISG, and the other firms that rank and evaluate our space.

The Director, Analyst Relations will build and run Argano’s analyst relations program from the ground up: the engagement strategy, the operating cadence, the executive preparation, the evaluation and RFI submissions, and the loop that brings analyst research and market insight back into our business units and go-to-market. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can set the strategy and also personally drive the briefing calendar, the submission tracker, and the executive prep deck.

You will report to the SVP of Marketing and work daily with Argano’s CEO, Chief Growth Officer, Presidents, business-unit and practice leaders, and the corporate marketing, communications, and demand-generation teams.

What You Will Do

Analyst engagement strategy

  • Build, own, and continuously refine a multi-year analyst relations strategy that supports Argano’s corporate and business-unit growth priorities — including which firms, analysts, and evaluations matter most, and why.

  • Map the analyst landscape across our publisher practices (Oracle, SAP, Microsoft, Salesforce, Workday, UKG, Anaplan, Blue Yonder, Databricks), our offerings (AI, Connect, Managed Services, HCM, Supply Chain, Revenue Operations), and our priority verticals (healthcare and life sciences, pharma, manufacturing, homebuilding, wholesale and distribution).

  • Recommend and manage analyst firm relationships and subscriptions, including scope, budget, renewals, and inquiry usage, so the company gets measurable value from every contract.

  • Define and report the KPIs for the program — inclusion and placement in key evaluations, briefing volume and quality, analyst sentiment, referenced mentions in research, inquiry usage, and analyst-influenced pipeline.

Evaluations, RFIs, and report submissions

  • Own the calendar of Magic Quadrants, Waves, MarketScapes, PEAK Matrix assessments, Horizons reports, Provider Lens studies, and other evaluations relevant to Argano; decide where we participate and manage the end-to-end response.

  • Project-manage each RFI and submission: assemble the cross-functional team, build the work plan, gather and validate data, coordinate customer references, write and edit the narrative, and deliver on time and to a high standard.

  • Prepare and coach executives and practice leaders for evaluation demos and briefings, and manage post-evaluation fact-checks, reviews, and debriefs.

  • Maintain a reusable library of company facts, proof points, case studies, metrics, and boilerplate so every submission is consistent, current, and on-message.

Briefings, inquiries, and executive preparation

  • Run a proactive briefing and inquiry program: secure the right analyst meetings, set objectives, build the narrative and materials, and follow up on commitments.

  • Prepare Argano executives ahead of every analyst interaction with concise briefing documents covering the analyst’s coverage, recent research, prior interactions, likely questions, and our key messages.

  • Manage analyst participation in Argano events, customer stories, and thought-leadership programs, and coordinate analyst speaking, quotes, and content licensing with marketing and communications.

  • Track every interaction, commitment, and outcome in a shared analyst relations system of record.

Voice of the market into the business

  • Monitor, curate, and distribute relevant analyst research to business-unit, practice, sales, and marketing leaders, with clear summaries of what it means for Argano.

  • Translate analyst research and inquiry insights into implications for positioning, offering development, competitive strategy, and go-to-market planning; partner with product marketing on messaging and with sales enablement on competitive intelligence.

  • Bring the outside-in perspective into planning cycles — quarterly business reviews, offering roadmaps, and annual marketing and growth planning.

  • Enable sales and delivery teams to use analyst recognition and research appropriately in pursuits, proposals, and client conversations.

Program operations

  • Establish the operating rhythm for the program: the annual plan, the quarterly review with executive leadership, briefing and submission calendars, and a reporting dashboard.

  • Manage analyst relations budget, agency or contractor support, and analyst firm contracts.

  • Ensure compliance with each analyst firm’s citation, quotation, and reprint policies, and with Argano’s brand and communications standards.

What You Bring

Required

  • 5–7+ years of experience in analyst relations, or a closely related mix of analyst relations, public relations, product marketing, or corporate communications, with demonstrated ownership of analyst programs and evaluations.

  • Direct working experience with Gartner, Forrester, IDC, Everest Group, HFS, ISG, or comparable firms, including managing Magic Quadrant, Wave, PEAK Matrix, or similar evaluation submissions from start to finish.

  • Strong understanding of the technology and professional services market, ideally within consulting, systems integration, managed services, or enterprise software.

  • Excellent executive-facing communication skills; able to distill complex research into crisp briefs and coach senior leaders with confidence and tact.

  • Outstanding writing and editing skills, with the judgment to keep submissions accurate, differentiated, and on-message.

  • Proven project management ability across multiple concurrent, deadline-driven, cross-functional workstreams.

  • Comfortable working hands-on in a growing organization where you build the process rather than inherit it.

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred

  • Experience at a consulting or services firm with multi-publisher practices (Oracle, SAP, Microsoft, Salesforce, Workday) and a background in how those ecosystems and their analyst coverage intersect.

  • Familiarity with services-industry evaluations such as the Everest Group PEAK Matrix, HFS Horizons, ISG Provider Lens, and IDC MarketScape.

  • Experience integrating analyst insight into product marketing, competitive intelligence, or account-based marketing programs.

  • Experience supporting a private-equity-backed or acquisitive company through brand and operating-model integration.

  • Working knowledge of AI, data, and connectivity trends shaping enterprise operations.

How Success Looks in Year One

  • First 90 days: Complete the analyst landscape map, audit current firm relationships and subscriptions, meet every executive and practice leader, and stand up the briefing calendar, submission tracker, and executive briefing template.

  • First 6 months: Publish the analyst engagement strategy and annual plan; deliver our first prioritized evaluation submissions on time and with executive-ready prep; launch a regular research digest for business-unit and GTM leaders.

  • First 12 months: Measurable movement in analyst awareness and positioning of Argano; inclusion in the evaluations we targeted; a running program dashboard; and analyst research visibly informing positioning, offerings, and sales enablement.

Why Argano

You will build a function, not maintain one — with direct access to the CEO, CGO, and SVP of Marketing and a mandate to shape how the market understands a company at an inflection point. You will work across a rare breadth of platforms, industries, and offerings, and see the direct line between the analyst relationships you build and the growth of the business.

Additional Information

Location and travel: This is a remote role based in the United States. Travel of up to approximately 20% is expected for analyst summits, executive briefings, and Argano events.

Background

Catholic Relief Services is the official international humanitarian agency of the Catholic community in the United States. CRS works to save, protect, and transform lives in need in more than 100 countries, without regard to race, religion or nationality. CRS’ relief and development work is accomplished through programs of emergency response, HIV, health, agriculture, education, microfinance and peacebuilding.

You will provide technical advice and support to a range of program design and implementation issues in the area of Food Security with a focus on humanitarian in-kind food assistance programming as well as Livelihoods and Markets in line with Catholic Relief Services (CRS) program quality principles and standards, donor guidelines, and industry best practices to Country Program (CP) teams to advance the delivery of high-quality programming to the poor and vulnerable. Your advice, knowledge, and support will contribute to determining how effective, adaptive and innovative CRS’ Market Based programming work is across the globe. You will also manage and provide technical oversight, coordination, and management of the implementation of the Sudan Country Program (CP)’s Preparedness Plan for Food and Nutrition Security Crises (FNS Plan). The FNS Plan is a World Bank-funded, cross-organizational effort to identify and respond to significant deterioration of food and nutrition security in Sudan before it becomes a major crisis.

Job Summary

This position is embedded in the Humanitarian Response Department (HRD) Market-based Rapid Response and Recovery (MBRRR) Team, with a dotted line to the CRS Sudan program. Job Title: MedTech Safety Project Lead

Job Location: Washington, District Of Columbia, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Summary

The MedTech Safety Project Lead provides operational, project coordination, and administrative support to the Clinical Safety team in the management of medical device and combination product safety activities across clinical and post-market programs. This role serves as a key coordinator of safety operations and independent safety review committees, ensuring accurate tracking, documentation, and communication of safety information while supporting project execution, regulatory compliance, and cross-functional collaboration.


Job Responsibilities

  • Provide day-to-day operational and administrative support to the Clinical Safety team across medical device clinical studies and post-market safety activities.
  • Serve as the primary operational coordinator for assigned safety projects and committee activities, ensuring deliverables, timelines, and documentation requirements are successfully executed.
  • Assist with management of independent safety review committees (Clinical Events Committees (CECs) and Data Safety Monitoring Boards (DSMBs)), including preparation of meeting materials, meeting participation, and appropriate documentation of meeting outcomes.
  • Coordinate safety-related project tracking, timelines, documentation, meeting scheduling, and action item follow-up.
  • Support the collection, review, and maintenance of safety documentation, including adverse event reports, product complaints, and safety tracking logs.
  • Assist with case intake, data entry, quality checks, and organization of safety records in accordance with internal procedures and regulatory requirements.
  • Prepare meeting materials, project status reports, metrics, and presentations for internal and client-facing discussions.
  • Participate in client meetings and support preparation of client-facing safety updates, reports, metrics, and presentations.
  • Partner with Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Medical Affairs, and project teams to ensure timely communication and resolution of safety-related activities.
  • Support inspection and audit readiness activities through maintenance of accurate documentation and safety records.
  • Assist with implementation and refinement of safety processes, workflows, and standard operating procedures.
  • Participate in safety team meetings and contribute to process improvement initiatives designed to enhance operational efficiency and compliance.
  • Maintain awareness of applicable FDA, EU MDR, ISO 14155, vigilance, and post-market surveillance requirements governing medical device safety activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Job Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Nursing, Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Public Health, Biology, Biomedical Sciences, or a related field.
  • Minimum 2 years of clinical, healthcare, clinical research, medical device, or patient care experience.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate documentation.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment .
  • Ability to participate in occasional early morning or evening meetings to support global teams and safety review committees. Flexible scheduling may be utilized to accommodate these requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting medical device clinical trials, clinical research, safety, quality, regulatory affairs, or complaint handling activities.
  • Familiarity with safety databases, clinical trial management systems (CTMS), electronic Trial Master Files (eTMF), or medical device complaint handling systems.
  • Familiarity with adverse event reporting, medical device vigilance, post-market surveillance, or product complaint processes.
  • Understanding of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), FDA medical device regulations, ISO standards, or MDR requirements.
  • Experience coordinating projects, meetings, or operational activities across multiple stakeholders.
