Tech Customer Support Administrator

At Sinch, we are a global leader in providing cutting-edge communication platforms, enabling businesses to connect with any mobile phone on the planet in seconds, or less. Our platform supports mobile SMS, rich messaging, voice, and video communication solutions for some of the biggest companies in the world.

The Tech Customer Support Administrator is a key member of Sinch global support team dedicated to ensuring the success of Sinch’s Voice and Verification customers. In this technical 2nd line service role, customer focus is central. You will be the trusted technical point of contact for complex issues, service management, and advanced routing configurations that are critical to our customers' success.

This position goes beyond traditional support; you will act as a service delivery champion, taking ownership of technical challenges and seeing them through to resolution. You will investigate and troubleshoot issues escalated from the 1st line team, manage service incidents, and ensure the quality and stability of our global traffic. Your role will involve configuring backend systems, analyzing traffic patterns, and collaborating closely with engineering and operations teams to resolve deep technical problems.

The ideal candidate has a strong technical aptitude and a passion for problem-solving. You are eager to develop a deep understanding of our business, our industry, and the complex products that power global communications. You will have the opportunity to not only solve immediate customer issues but also to collaborate with sales and product teams to enhance the customer experience and help our clients maximize the value they get from our services.

You are analytic, have a technical background, and love the challenge of digging into problems. You are driven, have no problem multitasking, and get inspired by being part of a team and company under development.

This role is open to candidates located in the Philippines, Malaysia, or China.

Job Responsibilities

Customer support & Incident Management

  • Serve as the primary escalation point for all technical support issues related to Sinch’s Voice and Verification services.
  • Identify, manage, and resolve complex customer issues, responding to technical inquiries and fulfilling service requests with a high degree of ownership.
  • Investigate and resolve service provider complaints, including issues related to fraudulent traffic patterns and traceback requests.
  • Champion initiatives to enhance the customer experience by providing data-driven feedback and guidance to internal stakeholders across the business.

Service Quality & Routing Management

  • Proactively monitor and analyze global traffic to ensure optimal routing, service quality, and performance.
  • Manage and optimize routing configurations based on quality, cost, and performance metrics, with a strategic focus on key customers and markets.
  • Administer customer account configurations, including number management, pricing implementation, and traffic routing rules.

Operational Excellence & Automation

  • Develop and maintain critical operational tools, including traffic dashboards, system alarms, and procedural runbooks.
  • Analyze daily performance data to proactively identify, investigate, and resolve potential service-impacting issues.
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for automation and increased operational efficiency to elevate service delivery standards.

Who are you?

At your core, you are a curious and analytical thinker who genuinely enjoys the challenge of a technical investigation. You have a positive, "can-do" attitude and find real satisfaction in not just solving a problem, but in seeing a customer thrive because of your help. For you, being part of a global team isn't just a job detail—it's an opportunity. You are excited by the idea of working with colleagues from all over the world and believe that different perspectives are key to personal and professional growth. 

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in a technical customer support or service delivery role (2nd line or higher preferred).
  • Background in the telecommunications industry, with strong, practical knowledge of SIP protocol and modern voice technologies.
  • Proven experience working with APIs, including the ability to use or build simple libraries/scripts for testing and troubleshooting.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting large, complex data sets to identify trends, troubleshoot issues, and drive decisions.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical information clearly to diverse audiences.
  • A quick learner, capable of adapting to new technologies and processes efficiently.
  • Flexible and willing to work occasional non-standard hours to support a global team and customer base.
  • Fluency in Mandarin is an advantage

What we promise to give you

  • Remote work setup
  • Birthday leave (day off on your birthday)
  • Additional vacation leave as outlined in the employee handbook
  • Health insurance coverage
  • Home internet allowance
  • Access to the Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Sinch Values

• Dream Big - We make the impossible possible by dreaming big to solve our customers’ problems and improve their businesses. Great things happen when we dare to challenge the status quo and find creative new ways to wow them. Driven by curiosity, we believe there is no such thing as failure, only continuous learning, and development. Having big, crazy, ambitious goals drives our success.

• Win Together - Great teams work faster and better together – creating meaningful impact for customers. Together as one global team, in close collaboration with our customers, we embrace diversity, meritocracy and care about every single individual. We build trust through open and honest relationships. It’s all about the team: being inclusive, respectful, and sharing our knowledge to empower all for personal growth. We collaborate, have fun and are stronger together.

• Keep it Simple - Sinch means simple and easy. It’s how we want customers to feel when dealing with us: uncomplicated, down-to-earth, and useful. Things stay simple when you are honest, open and act with integrity. Cut the fluff and talk straight! This also means spending our time and money wisely on things that really count. Eyes on the horizon, feet on the ground.

• Make it Happen - We make things happen and make them matter – for our customers and the world. We are “doers” who value getting results and don’t overthink matters. We stay accountable for our actions, apply the highest ethical standards to set ourselves apart and always deliver. If we’re not making an impact, we rethink the approach. Structure helps us, bureaucracy and excuses do not. No putting things off – let’s get it done now.

Do what you love

Who We Are

We’re Personified: a managed IT + cybersecurity services provider for campaigns, non-profits, and mission-aligned organizations. Our mission is to lead technology and security programs for our clients, enabling them to focus on their mission-critical work.

We act as an extension of our client teams — we handle all the responsibilities a traditional internal IT team would. We’re in our clients’ Slacks, we’re on a first-name basis with them (and their pets), we’re new hires’ first point of contact, and we’re the first stop for tech and cybersecurity issues. We aim to build trust, and we leverage this to keep the bad actors out.

Some of the biggest names in the progressive space have leaned on us as their trusted IT + cybersecurity partner. We are looking for top IT talent as we continue to scale our team.

About the Role

Personified is looking for a Senior Vice President of Technology to run the operational core of our technology organization: engineering, client support, cybersecurity, and IT operations. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who has run these functions inside a managed service provider before and knows exactly what breaks at scale: ticket queues, on-call rotations, security posture, tooling debt, and how to fix it without slowing the team down.

You'll report to the CTO and own execution across four functional leaders and the day-to-day delivery. You are the person who makes sure the trains run on time, the team is accountable, and our 97% client retention rate stays exactly where it is, or gets better.

This role exists because Personified is growing past the point where one person can run every function directly. We need someone who has done this before, who can walk into a room of client support engineers or a security incident and immediately know what questions to ask.

Key Responsibilities

  • Client Support & Service Delivery — Ensure the team hits our response-time and resolution standards across every client tier. Own escalation paths, staffing models, and the systems (like our Halo ticketing platform) that keep support predictable and measurable.
  • Engineering — Oversee infrastructure, systems engineering, and technical delivery. Set standards for process discipline, documentation, and accountability across the engineering team.
  • Cybersecurity — Own the operational security posture across our client base: monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, and compliance readiness. Make sure security isn't a side conversation — it's built into how we operate.
  • IT Operations — Drive the shift from manual, reactive IT operations toward automation and repeatable processes. Reduce the operational load on the team while improving consistency for clients.
  • People leadership — Directly manage functional leaders across these four areas. Set clear expectations, run a real performance management cadence, and build a bench of leaders under you who can eventually run without your direct involvement.
  • Cross-functional operations — Be the connective tissue between functions that too often operate in silos. When a client issue touches support, engineering, and security at once, you're the person who makes sure it gets resolved as one coordinated response, not three separate ones.
  • Metrics and accountability — Build and own the operational scorecard for technology delivery: response times, resolution rates, security incidents, retention impact. Bring data, not anecdotes, to every conversation with the CTO.
  • Travel or work or present onsite as needed to support business needs, ensure continuity of service, and represent Personified to our clients and partners at the highest level.

Skills + Experience

  • 8+ years in technology operations leadership, with at least 4 in a managed service provider (MSP) environment, you understand ticket economics, SLAs, multi-client environments, and the specific pressure of supporting many organizations at once rather than one.
  • Direct people-management experience across multiple technical functions simultaneously (not just one discipline). You've managed managers, not just individual contributors.
  • A track record of taking an under-disciplined operation and making it measurably more consistent, without making it slower or more bureaucratic.
  • Real fluency in cybersecurity operations; you don't need to be the deepest technical expert in the room, but you need to know enough to ask sharp questions and hold a security leader accountable.
  • Experience building or scaling IT automation — you should be able to speak concretely about a time you replaced manual process with something repeatable.
  • A communication style that is direct and specific. You document decisions. You don't let vague problems stay vague.

What Would Make You a Great Fit Here

  • You've worked with or served mission-driven, nonprofit, or advocacy organizations before, and you understand why 'the client hired us so they never have to think about IT again' is a real design principle, not a slogan.
  • You're comfortable in a smaller, fast-moving company where your title doesn't insulate you from doing real work.
  • You believe good process makes teams faster, not slower, and you can tell the difference between bureaucracy and discipline.
  • You want to build a team, not just manage one that already exists.

Reporting Structure

This role has direct management authority over the functional leaders in Client Support, Engineering, Cybersecurity, and IT Operations. It reports to the CTO, who retains direct ownership of Technical Programs and Training/Content, along with technology strategy, senior-level accountability, and cross-company initiatives.

Job Overview:

The Clinical Trial Manager II owns the clinical delivery and operational oversight of clinical research trials within the core project team. The CTM II collaborates with project managers and other functional leads to deliver clinical and start-up activities within budget and contract, ensuring quality, compliance and meeting country-specific commitments.

While the role may occasionally support larger, more complex trials under the guidance of a Senior Clinical Trial Manager, it is generally expected to manage most studies independently and comprehensively.

Summary of Responsibilities:

  • End-to-end oversight of start-up and clinical responsibilities—from site identification through to database lock—through proactive management of project scope, timelines, milestones, and budget.

  • Ensure start-up and clinical project plans address identified risks while adhering to professional standards, SOPs, client, and regulatory requirements.

  • Proactively identify and address start-up and clinical project, financial, and quality risks by applying comprehensive risk management strategies and ensuring compliance, including tracking within applicable systems.

  • Responsible for financial aspects of clinical and start-up activities, including revenue forecasting, adherence to contracted scope, and oversight of scope modifications.

  • Ensure project team awareness and tracking of Key Project Indicators (KPI) for any client-specific start-up and clinical metrics.

  • Ensure and plans for start-up and clinical resources with accurate projections for the resourcing teams.

  • Develop and implement the site activation and recruitment strategy in collaboration with project teams.

  • Lead and oversee site identification and site selection.

  • Oversight of Informed Consent Form development and translations.

  • Oversight of essential document creation and collection, including insurance.

  • Oversight of the development, negotiation, and execution of Clinical Trial Agreements (CTA), including site budgets.

  • Lead the end-to-end process of regulatory/ethics committee submissions, approvals, and tracking.

  • Ensure clinical and ancillary supplies -including import/export logistics and supply destruction processes- are in place as applicable.

  • Manage operational aspects to support subject recruitment and retention, patient safety, vendor performance, and the monitoring visit strategy.

  • Proactive planning for monitoring activities to ensure data integrity, patient safety and endpoint protection.

  • Ensure inspection-readiness through quality oversight of TMF, monitoring reports, protocol deviations and issue management.

  • Oversight and approval of site payments, including payment reconciliation.

  • Foster effective communication and collaboration with clients and cross-functional project teams in a global and multicultural environment.

  • Ability to lead client-facing calls to communicate project status updates and demonstrate operational control of start-up and clinical deliverables.

  • Support new business with active participation in pre-award preparation as required.

  • Provides training and support to new and/or junior team members

  • All other duties as needed or assigned.

Qualifications (Minimum Required):

  • University/college degree (life science preferred) or certification in a related allied health profession (nursing, medical, or laboratory technology) from an appropriately accredited institution.

  • Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements.

  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal

Experience (Minimum Required):

  • Comprehensive knowledge of GCP, ICH, and regulatory guidelines.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with EDC, CTMS, eTMF, and vendor platforms (e.g. Veeva Vault, Medidata).

  • Effective leadership in remote and global environment.

  • Strong communication, planning, and organizational abilities.

  • Proven team motivational skills.

  • Financial awareness and use of tracking systems/tools.

  • Demonstrated independent problem-solving and risk management mindset.

  • Demonstrated professional client interaction and presentation skills, with ability to work independently and collaboratively.

In this role, employees will leverage their existing experience and skills to assume additional responsibilities within the broader role. These will be aligned with operational requirements and internal training, without altering the fundamental nature or classification of the position.

  • Stay current with emerging AWS services, SRE methodologies, and cloud-native development technologies, and drive adoption of innovative solutions
  • Collaborate within Agile and Scaled Agile frameworks with cross-functional teams to deliver integrated cloud automation solutions

  • Bachelors Degree and 8 years of experience, or a High School diploma or equivalent and 12 years of experience

A great proposal is the difference between a captured opportunity and an awarded contract. We have the capture motion ramping up. We need the operator who turns the captured opportunity into a compliant, compelling, on-time response, and who builds the response library so every future proposal moves faster than the last.

What is already built

The Wilkinson Firm is a workforce strategy and staffing firm headquartered across NC and Atlanta. We launched in April 2025 and are now in Year 2 of operations. Two operational divisions today (HR Advisory for the mental health industry, Premium Hospitality and Event Staffing). Government Contracting division being formally stood up this quarter.   • Response library build: past performance citations, key personnel resumes, technical narratives, reusable management approach modules, pricing structures

  • Coordination with subcontractor partners on teaming inputs and price submissions

Engagement structure

Hourly consulting rate, three tiers calibrated to experience and scope:

  • Writer ($100-175/hr): Proposal writers and coordinators with 3-7 years federal proposal experience
  • Manager ($175-325/hr): Proposal managers with documented win history and full-lifecycle ownership
  • Principal ($325-500/hr): Senior proposal directors with multi-million-dollar award history and Tier 1 prime experience

Engagement is hourly. Per-proposal scope and budget defined at proposal kickoff. Win-based bonus stack negotiable on top of hourly rate for proposals that result in awarded contracts.

Success milestones

  • First 60 days: Proposal process documented. Compliance matrix template built. Response library framework established with 5+ reusable past performance citations.
  • First 120 days: First 1-2 proposals submitted on time, compliant, and competitive. Color-team review cadence established.

What we believe

Trust before revenue. Mission before money. Real seats, real upside. We build durable federal relationships through earned credibility. We win together. We pay people in real numbers, not pizza parties.

This role is ideal for an engineer who values reliability, quality, and outcomes over experimentation, and who can operate AI systems as durable operational capabilities embedded in core revenue workflows.

AI Engineering & Implementation

jobs.description:
The Senior Asset Manager, Commercial Servicing will provide proactive monitoring and surveillance of assigned assets securing Commercial Real Estate (“CRE”) loans, as well as being a source of information and training for Asset Managers. This is an individual contributor role that reports to a manager and will work hand-in-hand with various internal business units. The Senior Asset Manager will serve as the point of contact for the borrower and the assigned investor(s), provide oversight of an assigned portfolio, facilitate borrower requests, monitor and enforce loan covenants, resolve insurance non-compliance, complete financial analyses, delinquency resolution, be an escalation point for questions and inquiries from external clients and internal staff, and other responsibilities as need arises. This position requires the ability to provide best-in-industry customer service, interpret loan documents, compliance, quality control, provide mentorship to team members, and resolve a wide spectrum of borrower-related inquiries related to commercial loan servicing. This is a customer-facing position, and all interactions must be handled with a high degree of professionalism, courteous customer service, and promptness. Individuals in this role are required to adhere to investor servicing guidelines, internal policies and procedures.

Job Responsibilities and Requirements:

Customer Service:

  • Act as the primary contact for the borrower, investor, related third parties, and various internal business units in order to resolve all inquiries and servicing functions for the loan.
  • Maintain professionalism during all interactions.
  • Demonstrated ability to initiate difficult conversations while maintaining best-in-class customer service.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle escalated items during difficult conversations.

Portfolio and Asset Oversight and Servicing:

  • Quality Control check of loan boarding against the loan documents to ensure accuracy.
  • Coach team members on CRE loan document interpretation.
  • Identify & monitor loan covenants for borrower compliance to include letter of credit monitoring, cash management provisions, waterfall allocation, DSCR testing, occupancy triggers, etc.
  • Monitor Letters of Credit for expiration.
  • Interpret and work effectively with large data sets.
  • Expert monitoring of escrow and reserve functions within the CRE environment.
  • Work within a CRE loan servicing system and maintain data integrity.
  • Read, understand, and proactively monitor rent rolls, financial statements, property inspections, and other documents in order to address potential performance issues before they arise.
  • Strong knowledge of CRE loan participations.
  • Strong knowledge of CRE insurance coverage requirements.
  • Spread and analyze property level financial statements and provide training to Asset Managers for complex assets.
  • Create a pro forma based upon historical property performance and provide training to Asset Managers for complex assets.
  • Work closely with borrowers and investors to resolve delinquent payment issues as they arise.
  • Generate an amortization table and calculate various loan accounting items including, but not limited to, interest, default interest, prepayment premiums, yield maintenance, and escrow constants with no assistance.
  • Create, maintain, and monitor investor level watchlist.
  • Lead client calls and/or meetings reviewing loan performance issues.
  • Review loan draws submitted by the Borrower for accuracy and overall construction / renovation schedules and provide training to Asset Managers for complex draws.
  • Administer construction / rehab loan covenants, including periodic review of construction/rehab work schedule, progress reports and inspections, property stabilization performance schedules, budgets, and borrower equity earnout provisions
  • Proactive engagement with borrower regarding exit strategy and current market conditions as projects progress towards maturity.
  • Escalate items appropriately to Manager.
  • Prepare, Collaborate with Investor Reporting, and Review CREF-C Reporting Packages
  • Act as the first point of contact for all escalations from the team.

Complete Borrowers Requests:

  • Read and interpret CRE loan documents to determine Borrower Request eligibility.
  • Discuss and engage in conversations with borrowers and investors regarding borrower request submissions, requirements, and resolution with no assistance.
  • Exceptional understanding of additional document requirements for various borrower requests, including the ability to teach and mentor team members in their understanding.
  • Complete presentation-level write-ups and recommendations for various types of borrower requests.
  • Review and Approve write-ups completed by Asset Managers prior to presentation.
  • Exceptional familiarity with the following requests, documentation requirements, and processes:
  • Assumption
  • Collateral Substitution
  • Insurance Loss Processing
  • Insurance Non-Compliance Resolution and Waivers
  • Lender Placed Insurance
  • Loan Maturity Extension
  • Loan Modification
  • Partial Release of Collateral
  • Property Management Change

Other Responsibilities and Requirements:

  • Adapt quickly to various requests from multiple sources.
  • Prioritize multiple, simultaneous incoming requests.
  • Generate reports for investors as required.
  • Coordinate with internal departments for servicing functions as required.
  • Review and update internal policies and procedures as required.
  • Assist with audits as requested.
  • Lead team trainings.
  • Prepare presentation for investors, management, and internal business units.
  • Other duties as assigned.
  • Qualifications
  • Demonstrates positive attitude, adds to a positive team morale, and is eager to take on and learn new things
  • Four-year degree from an accredited University preferred or equivalent work experience
  • Minimum of 8 years of CRE loan servicing experience required, 1 – 2 years in a leadership position preferred.
  • Familiarity with the full CRE loan life cycle from onboarding through Mortgage Satisfaction.
  • High attention to detail
  • Strong proficiency in Word, Excel, Outlook, CoPilot, and other information processing programs
  • Bilingual (English and Spanish) is considered a plus
  • Self-motivated and work independently
  • Ability to perform complex calculations using calculators and systems is required
  • Ability to reason and exercise sound judgment
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately
  • Outstanding communications skills (including verbal, written and listening skills), with an emphasis on strong customer service, professional relationship building skills, conflict resolution, and having difficult conversations
  • Previous experience with REALSynergy servicing system is considered a plus

Intern - Business Operations

Would you like the opportunity to enhance the Akamai sales tech stack?

Join our Global Sales Tools and Support Team

Akamai is seeking an intern to join our Sales Tools and Support team. This team serves as the Architects of the GTM Ecosystem, bridging the gap between complex business needs and technical execution. We operationalize business architecture through the design, definition, and governance of the tools that power our global sales force.

Partner with the best

As a Business Operations intern, you will collaborate with Sales, Sales Operations, Channel Programs and other key stakeholders. You will be responsible for managing data hygiene, researching agentic use cases that will benefit our go-to-market teams and improving business processes in the Salesforce CRM and Partner Portal applications.

Make an impact in a fast-paced, visionary role

As a Business Operations intern, you will focus on the management of our "Source of Truth" while researching the next generation of sales productivity. You will work across our three pillars: Velocity, Data Integrity, and Knowledge Liquidity.

As a Business Operations Intern, you will be responsible for:

  • Maintaining Salesforce CRM and Partner Portal integrity by identifying inconsistencies and implementing scalable clean-up frameworks.
  • Researching and ideating "Agentic AI" use cases (Agentforce) to reduce administrative workload for sales representatives.

  • Facilitating feedback collection on Salesforce "Dynamic Forms" to simplify the internal user experience for our global sellers.
  • Authoring and maintaining high-quality documentation. You will ensure that our GTM Playbook is up-to-date, making complex system workflows easy for global stakeholders to understand and execute.

Do what you love To be successful in this role, you will:

  • Be currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program with a graduation date of December 2026 or later.
  • Move beyond just "reading data" to identifying the "Why" behind the numbers, recommending structural changes that align with our 2026 Roadmap.
  • Show an obsession with how emerging tech (like Agentforce) can transform a global GTM ecosystem.
  • Build bridges across Sales Ops, IT, and Product, proving you can navigate a complex global organization with confidence.
  • Value the "Long Game" by creating world-class documentation that ensures your contributions remain a "Source of Truth" long after your internship ends.

Work in a way that works for you

Connect with us on social media and see what life at Akamai is like!

We power and protect life online, by solving the toughest challenges, together.

At Akamai, we’re curious, innovative, collaborative and tenacious. We celebrate diversity of thought and we hold an unwavering belief that we can make a meaningful difference. Our teams use their global perspectives to put customers at the forefront of everything they do, so if you are people-centric, you’ll thrive here.

Working for you

About us

Akamai powers and protects life online. Leading companies worldwide choose Akamai to build, deliver, and secure their digital experiences — helping billions of people live, work, and play every day. With the world’s most distributed compute platform — from cloud to edge — we make it easy for customers to develop and run applications, while we keep experiences closer to users and threats farther away.

Join us

Are you seeking an opportunity to learn and make a real impact in a global technology company? Come join us and learn with a team of people who will energize and inspire you! By the end of your assignment, you will gain a network of encouraging colleagues ready to support you in your studies and beyond.

متدرب - العمليات التجارية

هل تودّ اغتنام فرصة لتعزيز منظومة تقنيات المبيعات لدى Akamai؟

هل تشعر بالحماس إزاء فرصة توظيف مهاراتك التحليلية في تشكيل مستقبل الذكاء الاصطناعي في مجال المبيعات؟

انضم إلى فريقنا العالمي المعني بأدوات المبيعات وخدمات الدعم

تبحث Akamai عن متدرب لينضم إلى فريق أدوات المبيعات وخدمات الدعم. يضم هذا الفريق مهندسي منظومة استراتيجية الدخول إلى السوق، الذين يعملون على سدّ الفجوة بين احتياجات الأعمال المعقدة والتنفيذ التقني. نحوّل هندسة الأعمال إلى واقع تشغيلي من خلال تصميم الأدوات التي تمكّن فعالية المبيعات العالمية لدينا وتحديدها وحوكمتها.

التعاون مع نخبة من الخبراء

بصفتك متدربًا في مجال العمليات التجارية، ستتعاون مع فرق المبيعات وعمليات المبيعات وبرامج الشركاء إلى جانب جهات معنية رئيسية أخرى. ستكون مسؤولاً عن إدارة جودة البيانات والبحث في حالات الاستخدام القائمة على الوكلاء التي من شأنها دعم فرق استراتيجية الدخول إلى السوق (GTM)، إلى جانب تحسين العمليات التجارية ضمن تطبيقي Salesforce CRMوPartner Portal.

اصنع تأثيرًا ملموسًا ضمن دور ديناميكي قائم على رؤية مستقبلية

بصفتك متدربًا في العمليات التجارية، ستركّز على إدارة "المصدر المرجعي الموحّد للبيانات (Source of Truth)"، بالإضافة إلى البحث في الجيل القادم من أساليب تعزيز إنتاجية المبيعات. ستعمل ضمن ركائزنا الثلاث الأساسية: سرعة الأداء وسلامة البيانات وانسيابية المعرفة.

في إطار دورك كمتدرب في العمليات التجارية، ستتولى:

●ضمان تكامل بيانات Salesforce CRM وPartner Portal عبر رصد التناقضات وتنفيذ أطر تنظيف بيانات قابلة للتطوير.

●البحث في حالات استخدام "الذكاء الاصطناعي الوكيل (Agentic AI)" وابتكارها (‏Agentforce‏) بهدف تقليل الأعباء الإدارية على مندوبي المبيعات.

●إنشاء لوحات معلومات في Salesforce وتصوّرات باستخدام Tableau Next لتزويد القادة برؤى قابلة للتنفيذ قائمة على الحقائق.

●تصميم عمليات قابلة للتكرار وتقييم فرص تكامل واجهات برمجة التطبيقات (API) لتبسيط تسجيل الصفقات وتعزيز وضوح مسار المبيعات.

●تسهيل جمع الملاحظات حول "Dynamic Forms" في Salesforce بهدف تبسيط تجربة المستخدم الداخلية للبائعين التابعين لنا على مستوى العالم.

●صياغة وثائق احترافية عالية الجودة والحفاظ عليها. ستتولى التأكد من أن دليل خطط دخول السوق محدّثًا، ما يسهّل فهمه وتنفيذه للأطراف المعنية على مستوى العالم.

حوّل شغفك إلى نجاح للتميّز في هذا الدور، يجب أن:

●تكون مسجلاً حاليًا في برنامج الإجازة أو الماجستير مع تاريخ تخرج في ديسمبر 2026 أو بعده.

●تتجاوز مجرد "قراءة البيانات" إلى فهم "الأسباب" الكامنة وراء الأرقام، مع التوصية بتغييرات هيكلية تتماشى مع خارطة الطريق لعام 2026.

●تظهر شغفًا عميقًا بكيفية إسهام التقنيات الناشئة (مثل Agentforce) في تحويل منظومة استراتيجية الدخول إلى السوق (GTM) على المستوى العالمي.

●تبنيَ جسور تعاون بين فرق عمليات المبيعات وتكنولوجيا المعلومات والمنتج، بما يثبت قدرتك على العمل بثقة واحترافية داخل شركة عالمية كبيرة ومعقّدة.

●تتبنّى منظورًا طويل الأجل من خلال إنشاء وثائق مرجعية عالمية الجودة، تضمن أن تبقى مساهماتك مصدرًا موحّدًا وموثوقًا للبيانات بعد انتهاء فترة التدريب.

اعمل بالطريقة التي تناسبك

يُعد هذا الدور مرنًا، ويمكن أداؤه من المنزل و/أو من مكتب Akamai المحلي (في الدولة المُعلَن عنها). يسعدنا مناقشة خيارات العمل المتاحة ضمن هذا الدور، ونشجّعك على التحدث مع مسؤول التوظيف بالتفصيل عند التقدّم للوظيفة.

تابعنا على منصات التواصل الاجتماعي واكتشف بيئة العمل في Akamai!

نُعزّز الحياة على الإنترنت ونحميها ونتغلّب على أعقد التحديات معًا.

في Akamai، نتميّز بالفضول والابتكار وروح التعاون والإصرار. نحتفي بتنوّع الأفكار ونتمسّك بقدرتنا على إحداث فرق حقيقي وذي معنى. توظّف فرقنا منظورًا عالميًا يضع احتياجات العملاء في محور جميع أعمالها، لذا إذا كنت تضع الإنسان في صميم اهتماماتك، فستجد بيئةً تدعم نجاحك هنا.

نعمل من أجلك

من خلال برامج التدريب والتدريب التعاوني، نوفر لك فرصًا حقيقية للنمو والازدهار وتحقيق إنجازات مميّزة. تُقدَّم المزايا المالية المخصّصة للمتدربين وطلاب التدريب التعاوني، بما في ذلك خطة 401k والتأمين الصحي، من خلال مزوّد الخدمات المُدارة (MSP). ويستفيد الطلاب أيضًا من المزايا التالية عبر برامجنا:

●الإرشاد

●تدريبات متخصصة في التطوير المهني

●فرص الاطلاع والتواصل مع القيادات العليا عبر جلسات حوار مفتوحة

●أنشطة تواصل وفعاليات اجتماعية مع متدرّبين من مختلف أنحاء العالم

●عرض المشروع النهائي أمام الشركة

●مزايا ممتعة تشمل منتجات تحمل علامة Akamai التجارية

نبذة عن الشركة

توفّر Akamai التجارب على الإنترنت وتحميها. وتختار الشركات الرائدة في كل أنحاء العالم Akamai لبناء تجاربها الرقمية وتقديمها وتأمينها، ما يساعد مليارات الأشخاص على العيش والعمل واللعب كل يوم. من خلال أكثر منصّات الحوسبة توزيعًا في العالم، من السحابة إلى الخوادم الطرفية، نُسهّل على العملاء تطوير التطبيقات وتشغيلها، مع إبقاء التجارب أقرب إلى المستخدمين وإبعاد التهديدات عنهم.

انضم إلينا

هل تبحث عن فرصة للتعلّم وإحداث تأثير حقيقي داخل شركة تكنولوجيا عالمية؟ تعال وانضم إلينا، وتعلّم مع فريق سيشجّعك ويُلهمك في كل خطوة! مع انتهاء فترة تدريبك، ستكون قد كوّنت شبكة من زملاء داعمين ومشجّعين، مستعدّين لمساندتك في مسيرتك الدراسية وأكثر من ذلك.

Bring a Trailer is part of the Hearst Autos family. BaT Auctions are the best way to buy and sell classic, collector, and enthusiast vehicles. We curate vehicles submitted by our audience and craft transparent auction listings that present the vehicles as they are—without superlatives or dubious used-car-lot language. BaT's ever-growing community of knowledgeable users vets each listing so potential buyers can bid with confidence.

Key Responsibilities (What You Are Doing)

  • Design, build, test, and maintain cloud-native microservices, APIs, and event-driven workflows using AWS serverless technologies including Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway, EventBridge, and SQS in TypeScript.

  • Troubleshoot production issues across cloud services and legacy integration points, identify root causes, and implement automated testing to prevent regressions.
  • Participate in code reviews, contribute to engineering documentation, infrastructure as code, observability improvements, and the team's on-call rotation to maintain platform reliability.

Qualifications (What We're Looking For)

  • 3+ years of experience developing production software, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong experience building backend services, APIs, and asynchronous applications using TypeScript and Node.js.
  • Hands-on experience developing cloud-native applications using AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway, EventBridge, SQS, and related serverless services.

  • Experience writing clean, maintainable, well-tested code with strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively within a remote, collaborative engineering team and work successfully across technical and non-technical partners.

Purpose

We are looking for a strategic, highly execution-oriented Content Marketing Manager to help build the next generation of content marketing at TP North America. This role will own our thought leadership webinar program, using Goldcast to create high-value experiences for priority buyer audiences and turn those experiences into scalable content that fuels engagement throughout the buyer journey.

The ideal candidate is a strong content strategist, editor, storyteller, and program manager who can turn executive expertise, customer insights, market trends, and TP’s differentiated capabilities into webinars and content that moves buyers from interest to consideration and buying action.

A major focus will be building a thought leadership and middle-of-the-funnel webinar engine, then extending the value of each webinar through GenAI-enabled and human-edited content—including short-form video, social, email, nurture, executive, and sales enablement assets.

The role supports both vertical and horizontal lines of business, developing content that addresses the priorities of key buyer personas and supports integrated marketing, ABM-focused demand generation, and sales programs.

This is an opportunity for a marketer who sees content not as an asset-production function, but as a growth engine.

This position is 100% work at home. While this position will be working from home, this candidate must be located within the US and Canada and be eligible to work in the US and Canada without sponsorship.

Responsibilities

Your Responsibilities

Thought Leadership & Webinar Program

Own and continuously evolve TP’s thought leadership webinar program using Goldcast.

Partner with the ABM/Integrated Marketing managers to develop an editorial calendar aligned to priority verticals, lines of business, buyer personas, and buying stages.

Identify high-value topics that address the business challenges, market trends, and strategic priorities of TP’s target buyers.

Partner with executives, subject-matter experts, customers, analysts, and industry influencers to develop differentiated content.

Manage the end-to-end webinar process, including topic development, speaker preparation, content creation, execution, follow-up, and performance analysis.

Create webinar briefs, speaker guides, moderator questions, talking points, promotional copy, and follow-up content.

Work with the ABM team to maximize registration, attendance, engagement, on-demand consumption, and post-event conversion.

Content Repurposing & GenAI Content Engine

Turn webinars, executive conversations, research, interviews, customer stories, presentations, and other long-form content into high-value content formats.

Leverage AI to accelerate ideation, content creation, and personalization—while maintaining strong human editorial judgment and brand standards.

Edit webinar recordings into “snackable” videos with compelling insights, executive perspectives, statistics, provocative questions, and actionable takeaways.

Develop strategies to turn webinars into evergreen content engines, extending their value beyond the live event through on-demand content and short-form snippets.

Content assets and experiences

Develop content—webinars, videos, blogs, infographics, POVs, FAQs, buyer guides, sales enablement snippets, executive briefs, customer case stories, buyers guides, etc.— that supports buyers through consideration, evaluation, and decision stages.

Translate complex TP solutions, capabilities, and customer outcomes into clear, compelling buyer-oriented content.

Identify content gaps across the buyer journey and make recommendations to address them.

Adapt content to the needs of key industries, personas, buying committees, and lines of business.

Email Nurture & Lifecycle Content

Develop content strategies and assets supporting 1:Many, 1:Few, ABM, and line of business email nurture programs.

Partner with Marketing, Sales, SDRs and CSMs to align content to accounts, personas, industries, buying stages and intent signals.

Create nurture sequences and content to progressively educate, engage, and move prospects toward sales conversations.

Optimize content based on engagement, conversion, and pipeline performance.

Vertical & Line of Business Marketing

Ensure consistent messaging and narrative across channels and campaigns to support TP’s priority verticals and horizontal lines of business.

Partner with leaders to identify emerging topics, customer challenges, market shifts, and subject-matter expertise that can become differentiated content.

Ensure content reflects the language, priorities, and buying criteria of the intended audience rather than simply describing TP’s capabilities.

Strengthen TP’s point of view in strategic growth areas including AI, CX, digital transformation, trust & safety, financial services, healthcare, and other priorities.

Maintain a centralized content calendar and establish standards, workflows, templates, and processes that improve content quality and speed to market.

Develop content briefs defining audience, business objective, buyer stage, key message, proof points, CTA, distribution strategy, and desired outcome.

Measurement & Optimization

Analyze performance to identify which topics, formats, personas, speakers, and content types drive the strongest engagement.

Continuously optimize the editorial calendar and content mix based on performance and buyer behavior.

Partner with Marketing Operations and Analytics to connect content engagement to account-level and pipeline outcomes.

Establish performance measures for content programs, including registration, attendance, engagement, on-demand consumption, MQL/engaged-account progression, and opportunity influence and pipeline contribution.

Qualifications

Qualifications

5+ years of B2B content marketing experience, preferably in technology, professional services, BPO, consulting, or another complex B2B environment.

Demonstrated experience developing and managing webinar and thought leadership programs.

Strong editorial and storytelling skills with the ability to turn complex ideas into clear, compelling executive-level content.

Experience creating content for middle- and bottom-of-funnel audiences and enterprise buying committees.

Experience developing email nurture content and supporting demand generation or ABM programs.

Strong understanding of B2B buyer journeys, content marketing, and integrated campaign strategy.

Hands-on experience with webinar platforms; Goldcast experience strongly preferred.

Experience using Generative AI tools for content creation and repurposing, with a strong understanding of where human editorial judgment remains essential.

Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple programs and stakeholders simultaneously.

Ability to work effectively with executives and senior subject-matter experts.

Highly analytical and comfortable using performance data to make editorial and content investment decisions.

Excellent written, verbal, editing, and presentation skills.

Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, global, matrixed organization.

Highly collaborative with an ability to influence matrixed sales and marketing teams.

Soft Skills

  • Collaboration
  • Communication
  • Emotional Intelligence
  • Open-Mindedness
  • Critical Thinking
  • Solution Orientation

  • AI Proficiency

It is our mission to always provide an environment where our employees feel valued, inspired, and supported, so that they can bring their best selves to work every day. We believe that when employees are happy and healthy, they are more productive, creative, and engaged.   • Work collaboratively in developing statements of work for projects.
  • Conflict management and resolution with team members.
  • Work closely with clients to gather and document business requirements, processes, and objectives.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams including functional consultants, technical developers, data migration specialists, and quality assurance resources.
  • Facilitate workshops, status meetings, and executive steering committee updates.
  • Ensure adherence to project governance, change management, and best practices.
  • Manage client expectations and maintain strong relationships throughout the engagement.

  • Oversee data migration, system integration, testing, training, and go-live support activities.
  • Identify and mitigate project risks while proactively resolving issues.

  • Prior consulting services background (Big 4, mid-market, or boutique ERP consulting firm).
  • Experience in one or more industry verticals such as manufacturing, distribution, or wholesale.

Description

Empower AI is seeking a Knowledge Center Tier I Agent to analyze and resolve support requests from the external industry partners and users of a Department of War agency on its portfolio of mission applications (e.g., DISS, NISS, NBIS). External users cannot access internal systems, so they reach the Knowledge Center through a dedicated toll-free number, support email, public web form, and public chatbot; the agent determines the nature, impact, and priority of each request, creates and manages the ticket in the Government's ITSM system on the user's behalf, resolves what can be resolved at Tier I (account, access, navigation, and common application issues), and decides when to escalate to the KC Escalation Coordinator and application resolver groups. Every ticket follows the email-based Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process. This is a primarily remote position. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers.

THIS IS A REMOTE ROLE WITH UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED.

JOB DUTIES:

  • Determine the resolution approach for Tier I external-user issues on DISS, NISS, NBIS, and other designated applications (account status, access and role questions, navigation, common errors) using knowledge articles and documented procedures, and decide when escalation to the KC Escalation Coordinator or application resolver groups is required.
  • Manage external-user communication through the email-based Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process (resolution notification, reply-to-confirm or reopen, three-business-day auto-closure), and safeguard sensitive user information in accordance with Privacy Act and CUI requirements.

  • Analyze escalated and complex Tier I incidents and service requests to determine root cause, scope, and business impact; independently set Priority Levels (PL1-PL4); and decide the resolution path, including whether to resolve, deflect to self-service, or escalate to Tier II/III or specialized resolver groups.
  • Determine and apply the appropriate diagnostic and remediation approach for Windows endpoints, Microsoft 365 and collaboration tools, VPN and network connectivity, account and access issues, printing, and mobile devices, exercising delegated administrative authority to resolve issues at first contact.
  • Serve as an escalation and decision resource for junior analysts, reviewing their proposed resolutions, approving or redirecting escalations, and coaching on troubleshooting methodology and ticket quality.
  • Evaluate ticket documentation and closures for compliance with the Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process and quality standards, identify patterns in reopened tickets, and recommend corrective actions to the Senior Analyst and Supervisor.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 3 years of related experience (an additional 4 years of related experience may be substituted for the degree).
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.
  • Must have an Active Secret Clearance (favorably adjudicated T3/T3R) to start.

  • Must be within investigation scope and/or currently enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting.

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment with limited day-to-day supervision.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365, Active Directory accounts and group membership, network connectivity (VPN, Wi-Fi, DNS/DHCP basics), printers, and mobile devices.

  • Ability to work assigned shifts within a 6:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET core schedule, and willingness to work extended-hours shifts (evenings, overnight, weekends, and holidays) if assigned to the extended-hours team.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-technical users and leadership.
  • Experience supporting external customers or the public through phone, email, and web channels; ability to work assigned shifts within 6:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET; this position primarily works remotely.

  • Experience writing knowledge articles and troubleshooting guides for both technicians and end users.

As a Social Series Producer/Director, you are responsible for bringing a show to life. Concepts come from our team, your job is to build from that foundation: developing scripts, casting talent, organizing logistics, leading crew, directing on set, and driving the edit until a fully realized series of episodes is ready to post. This is a highly collaborative role with frequent touchpoints and real input at every stage. You thrive with creative guardrails, not despite them.

  • Direct on set with a clear point of view while staying adaptive to real-world conditions
  • Lead post-production: guide the edit, give clear and actionable feedback, and drive the cut to lock

  • Strong instincts for short-form storytelling: pacing, structure, hooks, and what keeps an audience watching

Cientista de Dados Sênior

Ciência de Dados tem como objetivo desbravar novos caminhos para permitir que as empresas respondam às suas questões mais urgentes. Como pioneiros no processamento analítico intensivo de dados em larga escala e com alto nível de paralelismo, nossa missão é desenvolver uma abordagem completamente nova para gerar significado e valor a partir de conjuntos de dados em escala de petabytes, além de criar metodologias, ferramentas, métodos estatísticos e modelos inovadores.

Além disso, trabalhamos em colaboração com acadêmicos de destaque, especialistas do setor e engenheiros altamente qualificados para capacitar nossos clientes a gerar insights sofisticados e inéditos a partir dos maiores volumes de big data.

O que você irá alcançar

Como Cientista de Dados Sênior, você será responsável por liderar o desenho, desenvolvimento, fine-tuning e implantação de soluções avançadas de Inteligência Artificial Generativa e Ciência de Dados. Você trabalhará com equipes multifuncionais, líderes de negócios, engenheiros e especialistas de domínio para enfrentar desafios complexos de negócios, pesquisa e engenharia, transformando problemas ambíguos em soluções escaláveis que possam ser testadas, avaliadas e aplicadas em diferentes domínios.

Você irá:

  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais, líderes de negócios, engenheiros e especialistas de domínio para compreender requisitos complexos, definir soluções personalizadas de IA e Ciência de Dados e transformar desafios de negócios, pesquisa e engenharia em soluções escaláveis.
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento, fine-tuning, customização, avaliação e integração de modelos de linguagem de grande escala (LLMs), modelos pré-treinados e aplicações de IA Generativa para casos de uso específicos de negócios, pesquisa e indústria.
  • Aplicar técnicas avançadas de machine learning, processamento de linguagem natural (NLP), deep learning, métodos estatísticos e abordagens algorítmicas para aumentar a qualidade, confiabilidade e relevância dos modelos para o negócio.
  • Otimizar modelos e soluções analíticas para implantação em ambientes de nuvem, corporativos e com restrições de recursos, considerando desempenho, escalabilidade, custo e manutenibilidade.
  • Realizar testes, validações, monitoramento e avaliações rigorosas de desempenho das soluções de IA, incluindo aspectos relacionados à IA responsável, robustez e qualidade, além de fornecer orientação técnica, apoiar o compartilhamento de conhecimento e ajudar a estabelecer melhores práticas para entrega de soluções de IA Generativa e Ciência de Dados.

Dê o primeiro passo em direção à carreira dos seus sonhos

Cada membro da Dell Technologies traz algo único para a equipe. Veja o que buscamos para esta posição:

Requisitos Essenciais

  • Inglês avançado para interação constante com equipes e stakeholders internacionais, além de fortes habilidades de apresentação, especialmente para audiências executivas.
  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Inteligência Artificial, Estatística, Matemática, Física ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada com IA Generativa, incluindo LLMs, sistemas de IA Generativa e técnicas de processamento de linguagem natural; sólido entendimento dos conceitos de Ciência de Dados e IA Generativa; experiência com modelos de linguagem de grande escala; e familiaridade com técnicas e aplicações de NLP.
  • Fortes habilidades de programação em Python, proficiência em bibliotecas relevantes de machine learning e deep learning, familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento colaborativo (por exemplo, GitLab e Jira) e conhecimento dos conceitos fundamentais de projeto e análise de algoritmos.
  • Experiência sólida em fine-tuning, customização, avaliação e integração de modelos pré-treinados para aplicações específicas.

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Pós-graduação stricto sensu, como Mestrado ou Doutorado em Inteligência Artificial, Machine Learning, Ciência de Dados ou áreas relacionadas, concluída ou em andamento.
  • Experiência na implantação de modelos e aplicações de IA em ambientes de produção, incluindo soluções corporativas ou baseadas em nuvem; conhecimento de práticas de IA ética, responsável e confiável, incluindo avaliação, mitigação de riscos, privacidade e equidade; e experiência com métodos avançados baseados em LLMs, sistemas agentic, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), frameworks de avaliação, MLOps ou LLMOps.

This is a unique opportunity for a well-connected health policy professional to help shape the environment for the adoption of innovative genomic technologies within one of Europe's most influential healthcare markets.

The successful consultant will bring deep knowledge of the German healthcare and policymaking landscape, with the ability to engage credibly across government, self-governance bodies, clinical networks, patient organisations and industry associations. Working closely with our Global and EMEA Government Affairs teams, you will help position Oxford Nanopore as a trusted partner in the development of genomic medicine, health-data infrastructure and future reimbursement pathways.

We are particularly interested in individuals who understand the intersection of healthcare policy, diagnostics, genomics and innovation, and who are motivated by the opportunity to support the integration of next-generation sequencing technologies into clinical practice across rare disease, oncology and pathogen genomics.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategy and positioning: Develop the Germany government affairs plan and policy narrative for nanopore sequencing in genomic medicine, health-data infrastructure, reimbursement and preparedness.
  • Stakeholder engagement: Build compliant relationships with priority federal, self-governance, Länder, trade-association, clinical-network and patient stakeholders, including BfArM/genomDE/MV GenomSeq, G-BA/IQWiG and VDGH.
  • Policy intelligence: Monitor § 64e SGB V, genomDE, GDNG/FDZ Gesundheit, EHDS, IVDR, ePA and reimbursement developments; summarise implications, risks and opportunities.
  • Evidence and access: Support Market Access, Medical/Clinical Affairs, Regulatory and technical teams on evidence gaps, validation requirements and policy barriers in rare disease, oncology and pathogen genomics.
  • External representation: Support agreed policy forums, association work, stakeholder briefs, meeting readouts, roundtables, consultation inputs and position papers, in conjunction with central Government Affairs team.
  • Compliance and reporting: Maintain stakeholder maps, engagement trackers and monthly intelligence notes; ensure activities follow Oxford Nanopore policies, German transparency requirements and Legal/Compliance review.

Experience:

Essential
  • Native or fluent German speaker with strong English
  • Significant experience in German health policy/government affairs
  • Strong understanding of Germany’s healthcare system, including federal/Länder structure and key decision-making bodies
  • Proven ability to credibly engage with public institutions, clinicians, and scientific stakeholders
Desirable
  • Experience in genomics, diagnostics, or precision medicine
  • Familiarity with key frameworks (e.g. §64e SGB V, G-BA/IQWiG processes, genomDE, EHDS)
  • Existing network across government, policy and to some extent university hospitals, research institutes, or relevant agencies
  • Understanding of the wider EU policy landscape and the role of Brussels

Success Measures

Germany is an institution-led market where clinical adoption depends on validation, governance, and reimbursement systems rather than commercial access alone. This role is therefore critical to ensuring ONT is embedded within the structures that define long-term clinical scale.

Schedule: This is a full-time day shift, remote position! Will have to attend on-site General Orientation.

The Impact You Can Make

As an Oncology Data Specialist (ODS®), you will analyze all forms of medical records extracting clinical, pathological, therapeutic and epidemiologic data. Abstract and code all malignant and reportable benign conditions diagnosed and/or treated throughout the Glens Falls Hospital system for all pathologically or clinically diagnosed cases including imaging or cytology. Oncology data is a specialized field that supports cancer care without being on the front lines of patient care.

How You Will Fulfill Your Potential (Responsibilities)

  • Abstracting – Assign correct codes using all manuals, coding and staging schemas in current use. Thorough documentation to support coding choices. Must be able to recognize basic cell types for classification purposes. Analyze electronic & paper medical records, extract clinical, pathological, therapeutic and epidemiologic data according to established oncology data collection practices & standards. Accurately enters all information into the registry software in adherence with regulatory timeliness guidelines.

  • Follow-up – Continuous follow-up through the initiation of first course of treatment for thorough documentation of complete therapies planned and administered. Documentation to include reason no treatment when applicable.

  • Case finding / Accessioning – Determine if a case qualifies for accessioning using all manuals, coding and staging schemas in current use, prepare and abstract data on all patients receiving diagnosis and/or treatment care.

  • Cancer Program Support – Maintains the cancer registry in accordance with accepted ACoS CoC standards, NYSCR regulations, and GFH guidelines. Provides support for oncology case conference in the absence of the Oncology Data Management Coordinator.

  • Professional Development – obtain continuing education units as required to maintain ODS credential, participate in professional organizations, meetings and educational programs to advance knowledge and expertise in registry data management.

What You Bring (Qualifications)

  • Education: Minimum Associates degree required; Bachelor’s preferred. Continued education maintained for ODS credential per NYS DOH and CoC regulations.

  • Experience: Minimum 3 years of experience in related healthcare field or practicum in an NCRA accredited program.

  • Skills/Abilities:

OVERVIEW

The Company

U.S. Financial Technology (U.S. FinTech) is seeking an experienced Director of Cyber Security Operations to join our team of talented professionals. This is a full-time remote opportunity.

U.S. FinTech built and operates the largest and most advanced mortgage securitization platform in the world, supporting the Uniform Mortgage-Backed Security (UMBS) of Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac.

Supporting 70% of the mortgage-backed securities in the market, U.S. FinTech provides best-in-class single-family issuance, bond administration, disclosure, and tax services. We support a broad portfolio of products for our clients with full lifecycle management.

Our market-leading, cloud-based, end-to-end platform executes transactions on an extraordinary scale which has bolstered liquidity in the secondary mortgage market, one of the largest and most important financial markets in the world. Our unique approach to securitization combines the best minds in financial services with the know-how, flexibility, and innovation of leading technologists.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Job Information

The Director of Cyber Security Operations leads enterprise-wide security operations that protect the organization’s cloud-native and hybrid infrastructure, data, employee, and digital assets. This position is accountable for end-to-end cybersecurity monitoring, incident response, digital forensics, and supporting risk-reduction programs that preserve resilience and regulatory compliance. The role oversees advanced security architecture and tooling (SIEM, SOAR, AI/ML analytics), defines and reports organizational risk posture to executive leadership and regulators, and drives continuous innovation through process automation and technology modernization. This leader develops high-performing teams across monitoring, response, engineering, and cloud disciplines while integrating cybersecurity operations with enterprise IT and infrastructure functions to maintain audit-ready, financial-grade defenses.

Key Job Functions

  • Lead and mature enterprise-scale monitoring operations, including 24×7 Security Operations Center (SOC) oversight, real-time detection and alerting programs, telemetry optimization, and automation to reduce mean time to detect and respond.

  • Direct incident response and forensics programs, coordinating containment, eradication, and recovery across infrastructure and application domains while managing executive and regulatory communications during major security events.

  • Support risk-reduction initiatives encompassing vulnerability management, secure configuration baselines, patch governance, system integrity/authorized change, and compliance alignment for reduction in residual enterprise risk.

  • Architect and operationalize security platforms and analytics, implementing SIEM, SOAR, and AI/ML-driven tooling that enhance detection, automation, and response at enterprise scale.

  • Support cloud-native, hybrid and associated security operations, embedding DevSecOps practices, workload segmentation, and identity governance across cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Define and report cyber-risk posture to executive leadership and regulatory bodies, aligning operational practices with enterprise risk frameworks and audit requirements.

  • Drive innovation and process automation in cybersecurity operations, evaluating emerging technologies to enhance predictive detection, orchestration, and operational efficiency.

  • Build, mentor, and lead high-performance cybersecurity teams across monitoring, response, engineering, and cloud disciplines, ensuring accountability and professional growth.

  • Integrate cybersecurity operations with infrastructure and IT processes, enforcing secure configuration standards, consistent baselines, and unified incident management workflows.

  • Represent the organization in audits, examinations, and crisis events, ensuring compliance with federal, financial, and industry-specific regulatory requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related field required; Advanced degrees (MS, PhD) strongly preferred.
  • Industry Certification required, e.g. GSOM, GSOC, CISSP, CISA, CISM or equivalent designation.

Minimum Experience

  • Minimum of 10 years experience:
    • Leading enterprise-scale monitoring operations, including 24×7 Security Operations Center management, real-time detection and alerting programs, “eyes-on-glass” analyst oversight, telemetry and log pipeline optimization, and the development of automated response processes to reduce mean time to detect and respond.
    • Directing comprehensive incident response and forensics functions, encompassing major incident handling, digital evidence collection, post-mortem analysis, executive and regulator engagement during breaches, and coordination with infrastructure and engineering teams to ensure containment and eradication of threats.
    • Architecting and operationalizinge advanced security platforms and tooling, including implementation of SIEM/SOAR systems, integration of AI/ML analytics into detection and response workflows, deployment of new enterprise-wide security solutions, and definition of long-term technical roadmaps for operational resilience.
  • Minimum of 6-10 years experience:
    • Managing enterprise-level risk-reduction programs, covering vulnerability management, compliance alignment, secure configuration baselining, patch governance, and audit remediation—driving measurable decreases in residual risk and ensuring adherence to regulatory and cybersecurity control frameworks.
    • Overseeing cloud-native cybersecurity operations, ensuring protection of workloads across cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP); embedding DevSecOps practices; maintaining compliance within virtualized and hybrid infrastructures; and governing identity, access, and workload isolation in dynamic cloud environments.
  • Applicants must be authorized to work in the US without requiring employer sponsorship currently or in the future. U.S. FinTech does not offer sponsorship for this position.

Specialized Knowledge & Skills

  • Deep expertise in Security Operations Center (SOC) design and management, including tiered analyst structures, alert triage workflows, and automated incident response orchestration.
  • Advanced proficiency in incident response leadership, including containment, eradication, digital forensics, and crisis communications with executive and regulatory stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to architect and maintain SIEM and SOAR platforms (e.g., Splunk, Power Automate, Scripting, KQL), optimizing correlation logic, enrichment pipelines, and playbook automation.
  • Strong knowledge of AI/ML integration in cybersecurity, including behavior-based analytics, anomaly detection, and large language model applications for threat hunting and automation.
  • Expertise in vulnerability management and risk reduction, including threat-based prioritization, patch lifecycle governance, secure configuration baselines, and exposure, and leveraging that information to drive threat and compromise detection.
  • Advanced understanding of secure cloud architecture and DevSecOps practices across AWS, Azure, and GCP, including workload isolation, zero-trust principles, and continuous compliance monitoring.
  • Proficiency in digital forensics and evidence preservation, including memory, disk, and network artifact analysis aligned to legal and regulatory standards.
  • Demonstrated capability to lead cybersecurity risk governance, mapping technical controls to NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and FHFA/Fed examination requirements, combined with strong understanding of regulatory and audit frameworks impacting fintech operations and enterprises.
  • Strong command of cybersecurity automation and orchestration frameworks, integrating endpoint, identity, and network telemetry into cohesive operational pipelines.
  • Strong knowledge in identity and access management (IAM), least-privilege enforcement, privileged-access controls, and integration with cloud-native identity providers.
  • Experience implementing and tuning data loss prevention (DLP), insider risk, and threat intelligence programs to detect anomalous user and data activity.
  • High fluency in security metrics and KPI development, including incident trends, dwell time analysis, patch compliance, and automation ROI reporting to executives.
  • Significant skills in cross-functional program leadership, aligning cybersecurity operations with IT, infrastructure, compliance, and product engineering teams.
  • Expertise in vendor and third-party risk management, including integration of external threat intelligence and performance monitoring.
  • Ability to design and execute enterprise cybersecurity testing and validation programs, including tabletop exercises, red team coordination, and control assurance.
  • Strong communication and executive presentation skills, translating technical risk into business impact for boards, regulators, and senior stakeholders.
  • Track record of innovation and continuous improvement, leveraging automation, ML/AI, and analytics to modernize cybersecurity operations at scale.
  • Exceptional leadership and team-building acumen, with the ability to recruit, mentor, and retain top technical talent across multiple cybersecurity domains.
