jobs.excerpt: OverviewAbout LSACThe Law School Admission Council (LSAC) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to supporting the legal education community and helping individuals on their journey to law school.
jobs.description:
Overview

About LSAC

The Law School Admission Council (LSAC) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to supporting the legal education community and helping individuals on their journey to law school. LSAC’s mission is to advance law and justice by promoting access, equity, and fairness in law school admission, to broaden the pathway into legal education, and to support law schools, law students, and the legal education community.

Best known for administering the Law School Admission Test (LSAT), LSAC also provides a wide range of services that assist both prospective students and law schools, including law school application processing, resources and guidance for candidates, data-driven tools, and detailed research into legal education trends. Each year, the organization processes academic credentials for approximately 80,000 law school applicants, provides admissions technology and critical information resources to both applicants and law schools, delivers educational programs and conferences for legal education professionals, publishes research, funds outreach initiatives, and offers comprehensive LSAT preparation tools and law school admissions guidance.

As a leader at the intersection of legal education, assessment, technology, inclusive excellence, and public policy, LSAC is actively transforming its business to strengthen and expand its impact across several key areas, including legal education technology and service solutions, law school admissions support, candidate assessment, credential processing, and resources and strategic support that help law schools advance access to legal education and the legal profession.

LSAC’s ongoing innovation and evolution to address new challenges and opportunities positions LSAC to continue serving as a trusted partner to law schools, aspiring legal professionals, and the broader legal education ecosystem.

Purpose of Position

LSAC is seeking a Vice President for Strategic Initiatives to support the continuing definition, development, and execution of LSAC’s strategic vision. As a key member of the executive leadership team and in partnership with the President and CEO (President) and senior leadership, the Vice President for Strategic Initiatives identifies growth opportunities, evaluates market trends, and drives enterprise-wide transformation to advance the mission. The person in this position will work closely with the President to carry out special initiatives assigned by the President.

Applications will be accepted through October 30, 2026.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position. The individual employed in this position will be required to:

Strategic Collaborative Leadership

  • Support the implementation of LSAC's strategic priorities, in partnership with the leadership team. Advise President on alignment, shaping, and prioritization of strategic initiatives.
  • Facilitate recurring strategic planning, roadmap updates, and adjustments through discussions with the leadership team.
  • Advise the President and Board of Trustees on strategic opportunities, risk and risk management, and developments in the legal education ecosystem and assessments field.
  • In collaboration with the leadership team, translate organizational vision into measurable strategic objectives and initiatives.
  • Collaborate with senior leaders to streamline initiatives, work with teams across the organization to define priorities, track progress, and adjust prioritization as needed.

People Leadership

  • Lead and grow a high-performing, multidisciplinary team, encouraging collaboration, communication, accountability, and innovation in day-to-day work across the organization.
  • Develop and manage departmental budgets within a team with a focus on impact, agility, and long-term value.

Business Initiatives

  • Identify and evaluate new market opportunities, products, services, and business models.
  • Drive mission-based growth initiatives that strengthen LSAC’s work in supporting legal education.
  • Assess strategic partnerships, joint ventures, and other collaborative opportunities to advance LSAC’s mission; partner with Legal and Finance to conduct due diligence and assess the financial and operational impacts of such partnerships.
  • Support collaborative work in the legal education, higher education, and prelaw community.

Business Intelligence

  • Monitor industry trends, emerging legislation that impacts legal education, competitive activities, and market needs.
  • Conduct market analysis and provide strategic recommendations to President and leadership team.
  • Develop frameworks to anticipate disruptions and capitalize on emerging opportunities.
  • Integrate legal education research findings and trends into LSAC strategic priorities and goals.
  • Promote research, analysis and guidance on legal education to continue LSAC’s position as a thought leader in the legal education profession.

Enterprise Transformation and Innovation

  • Lead enterprise-wide transformation and change initiatives through project management, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Facilitate implementation of strategic projects that improve organizational effectiveness and value to stakeholders.
  • Align strategic priorities with operational execution.

Performance Management

  • Establish and monitor performance metrics tied to strategic objectives.
  • Track progress against strategic plans and communicate results internally and externally, so staff, member schools, the Board and other stakeholders understand LSAC’s priorities and how those goals advance the mission.
  • Recommend adjustments based on performance and market conditions.

Executive and Board Engagement

  • Prepare strategic presentations and recommendations for executive leadership and the Board of Trustees.
  • Influence decision-making through data-driven insights and business analysis.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the CEO and leadership team.
  • Work with external audiences, as appropriate, to represent LSAC and its work.
  • Complete projects as assigned by the President.

Competencies

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong sense of accountability for both individual and team objectives.
  • Forward-thinking mindset, contributing to a culture of continuous improvement and creativity.
  • Exceptional trust and relationship building skills along with the necessary diplomacy and tact to collaborate and partner with a variety of internal and external stakeholders; must be able to manage interpersonal relations with empathy and integrity. 
  • Excellent time management, prioritization, attention to detail and organization skills
  • Strategic thinking with the ability to execute vision into meaningful work with measurable results.
  • Financial and business acumen.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise confidentiality and sound independent judgment.
  • Ability to relate to law school volunteers, legal educators, associations, and staff in an effective manner.
  • Willingness and aptitude to learn accessibility best practices and standards when creating shared work product. 

Qualifications

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree required. J.D. degree strongly preferred.
  • Minimum eight (8) years of experience in strategy, consulting, higher education, operations, or other related industries. Minimum of three (3) years managing people and leading teams.
  • Experience leading enterprise-wide strategic initiatives.
  • Experience working directly with executive leadership, external boards, and external stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated success developing, communicating and executing growth strategies.
  • Familiarity with the goals, operations, and legal needs of academic institutions, particularly law schools, or not-for-profit, membership organizations required.

Additional Information

Supervisory Responsibilities: This role has people management responsibilities. The position will oversee the Business Intelligence and Initiatives, Applied Research, Legal Education Strategy and Project Management teams.

Position Type: This is an exempt position. The LSAC standard business hours are Monday-Friday, 8:30 a.m. - 4:45 p.m. ET. While these are the standard office hours for LSAC, as an exempt employee, the employee will be expected to work the hours necessary to satisfactorily complete their assignments in a responsible and professional manner.

Work Environment: This job operates in a remote and professional office environment. Whether remote or in-office, this role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.

Location: Remote

Travel Requirements: Up to 25% travel time is required for this position.

Reports to: President and CEO

Salary range: $245,000-$275,000

LSAC will be accepting applications through October 30, 2026.

At LSAC we foster a culture based on our stated values and actively seek to broaden our pipeline of current and future leaders. We are committed to attracting, retaining, and developing individuals who have a passion for the work they do and the mission of LSAC. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply. We recognize that experience comes from a variety of places and know that job applicants will possess many, but not necessarily all, of the qualities listed in the job description. While no one candidate will embody every single quality, the successful candidate will exemplify a robust combination of the skills and competencies listed to excel in the position. LSAC is an Equal Opportunity Employer and welcomes applications from individuals from all identities and backgrounds.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT SINCHSinch is pioneering the way the world communicates.
jobs.description:
ABOUT SINCH

Sinch is pioneering the way the world communicates. More than 150,000 businesses — including Google, Uber, Paypal, Visa, Tinder, and many others — rely on Sinch's Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email.

Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey.

At Sinch we "Dream Big", "Win Together", "Keep it simple", and "Make it Happen". These values are our foundation!

DESCRIPTION

The Customer Experience Analytics (CXA) team is an enablement team: we sit between how product data is created and how it's consumed across the company. On the creation side, we help Product and Engineering teams define event schemas and taxonomy so that data is generated consistently and reliably from the source. On the consumption side, we help other teams use that data in a simple, self-service way. In between, we own data quality, governance, and monitoring — making sure data stays trustworthy from creation to consumption.

This is a mid-level role. We're not looking for someone who already has every tool or years of polished experience — we're looking for someone with solid analytical fundamentals who is genuinely motivated to learn, adapts quickly, and takes ownership of problems until they're resolved. You'll grow into the specifics of our stack; what matters most is how you think and how you work.

You'll work with global teams across time zones, partnering with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Software Engineers, and Customer Success. Our stack today includes RudderStack, Snowflake, dbt, and Tableau, and we're migrating toward BigQuery and Looker — but familiarity with these specific tools is not a requirement (more on that below).

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Data Quality & Schema Governance: Help define, document, and evolve event schemas and tracking plans. Monitor data quality end-to-end, investigate issues from a metric back to its source, and support the lifecycle process for new and deprecated events.
  • Self-Service Enablement: Build and maintain data models, dashboards, and documentation that let Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders answer their own questions without depending on our team for every request.
  • Pipeline & Data Modeling: Create and maintain clean, reliable, well-tested data models that other teams and downstream tools can depend on.
  • Behavioral & Customer Journey Analysis: Use SQL and product analytics tools to help map user behavior and the customer journey when it's needed to support a schema, quality, or enablement decision — this is part of the job, not the primary focus of it.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Act as a reliable point of contact for Product and Engineering teams on data definitions, event tracking questions, and governance decisions.
  • Data Culture: Train stakeholders to use self-serve analytics tools autonomously, and help spread good data practices across the organization.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Some experience in Data Analytics, Analytics Engineering, or a similar role — we care more about your ability to learn fast and take ownership than about years of experience.
  • Solid SQL fundamentals, with the ability to reason about schemas and data structure, not just write queries.
  • Comfortable learning new tools quickly; you don't need prior experience with our specific stack.
  • Strong ownership mindset: you take on problems, work through them independently, and know when and how to ask for help when you're stuck.
  • Genuine curiosity about data quality, taxonomy, and how data is structured "under the hood" — not just about the insights on top of it.
  • A bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business-related subject (e.g., Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or similar) — or equivalent practical experience.
  • Advanced fluency in English, both verbal and written.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Exposure to event-driven tracking, product event architecture, or Customer Data Platforms (e.g., RudderStack, Segment).
  • Hands-on experience with dbt, BigQuery, Looker and similar tools.
  • Experience mapping or analyzing the customer journey (funnels, retention, cohort analysis).
  • Experience working in a global company across multiple time zones.
  • Telecom, CPaaS, or B2B SaaS experience.
  • Advanced fluency in English, both verbal and written.

BENEFITS

  • Stay Healthy: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • Flexible Benefits: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • Family First: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • Everyday Wellbeing: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • Secure Your Future:Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • Diversity and Inclusion: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • Take a Break: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.

OUR HIRING PROCESS

We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.

We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!

Department Overview

The Hospital Sr Revenue Cycle Analyst is responsible for the implementation, optimization, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance of Epic Revenue Guardian functionality to support compliant charge capture, revenue integrity, and reimbursement optimization across OHSU and its affiliates. This role serves as the primary subject matter expert for HB Epic Revenue Guardian and works collaboratively with the Revenue Cycle Team, Clinical Operations, Patient Financial Services, Coding, Compliance, Clinical Informatics, and Information Technology teams to identify revenue leakage, mitigate billing risks, and improve revenue cycle performance.

Function/Duties of Position

HB EPIC Revenue Guardian Analysis, Design & Development

    • Analyze and resolve Revenue Guardian alerts, exceptions, and system-generated charge issues.
    • Design and implement automated controls to improve charge capture accuracy and reduce revenue leakage.
    • Monitor Revenue Guardian performance and continuously refine business rules to improve outcomes.
    • Collaborate with Revenue Cycle system analysts to deploy upgrades, enhancements, and system changes.

Problem Resolution

  • Identify trends in missed, incorrect, duplicate, or delayed charges and recommend corrective actions.

  • Work with analysts to investigate problems to determine if it is necessary to resolve, if needed, escalate it to leadership.

  • Communicate problem progress and resolution.

  • Thorough documentation of decision outcomes.

  • Timely resolution of WQs and attention to root cause resolution to prevent ongoing charge lag issues.

Data Analysis and Reporting

  • Analyze large datasets to identify operational trends, financial risks, and improvement opportunities.

  • Present findings and recommendations to leadership, revenue cycle analysts, departments, and other stakeholders.

  • Monitor productivity, charge lag and volume using various Epic system tools and reports. Identifies and helps prevent backlogs and other impediments to charge capture. Monitors charge review work queues daily to prospectively identify problems, potential backlogs and take the necessary steps to mitigate impact.

Experience

jobs.excerpt: OverviewPaige Renewable Energy, a GCG company, is seeking an experienced Electrical Design Estimator to join our growing Paige Energy team and support utility-scale renewable energy projects across North America!
jobs.description:
Overview

Paige Renewable Energy, a GCG company, is seeking an experienced Electrical Design Estimator to join our growing Paige Energy team and support utility-scale renewable energy projects across North America!

As our Electrical Estimator, you’ll translate customer drawings, specifications, bills of material, and project requirements into accurate, executable estimates. You’ll perform detailed material takeoffs, develop project pricing, identify scope or design issues, and work closely with Sales, Engineering, Project Management, Supply Chain, and manufacturing partners to help ensure projects are positioned for successful execution.

This is a strong opportunity for someone who combines practical electrical knowledge with exceptional attention to detail and ownership. You should be comfortable working through large, complex project packages, asking thoughtful technical questions, challenging assumptions when something does not look right, and taking responsibility for the accuracy and completeness of your work.

While this role offers a remote work environment, we are seeking candidates in either the Eastern or Central Time Zone to align with the work schedule of the existing team.

What You’ll Do

  • Review RFQ packages, electrical drawings, site layouts, single-line diagrams, specifications, bills of material, and related documentation to understand project scope and requirements.

  • Perform detailed electrical material takeoffs, including cable lengths, harness and string counts, connectors, assemblies, accessories, and other project-specific materials.

  • Develop project estimates incorporating material costs, vendor pricing, freight, manufacturing costs, customer requirements, and other project-specific considerations.

  • Identify drawing discrepancies, missing information, scope gaps, incompatible materials, and other potential risks while clearly documenting assumptions, exclusions, and required clarifications.

  • Validate critical quantities, material selections, calculations, and drawing revisions before estimates are released.

  • Coordinate with Supply Chain and manufacturing partners to obtain and validate supplier pricing, lead times, freight requirements, and other cost inputs.

  • Support proposal development, design revisions, value-engineering opportunities, Best and Final Offer (BAFO) activities, and estimate revisions throughout the sales process.

  • Evaluate changes between estimate revisions and clearly communicate impacts to quantities, scope, cost, materials, and project requirements.

  • Maintain organized, traceable estimating files and supporting documentation that allow estimates to be independently reviewed.

  • Participate in project award and handoff activities, confirming that final estimates, quantities, assumptions, pricing, and scope align with the awarded project and customer purchase order.

  • Support estimating needs related to project changes, additional material requests, spare parts, and change orders.

  • Help improve estimating templates, tools, checklists, standards, and review processes by incorporating lessons learned from awarded and completed projects.

What You’ll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of electrical estimating experience, or equivalent electrical construction or design experience that includes estimating and material takeoff responsibilities.

  • Demonstrated ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, single-line diagrams, site plans, specifications, and bills of material.

  • Experience performing detailed material takeoffs and developing project estimates.

  • Strong understanding of electrical materials, cable, conductors, connectors, and electrical distribution systems.

  • Strong mathematical and analytical skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and experience using Bluebeam or similar takeoff and document-review software.

  • Strong organizational, communication, and collaboration skills with the ability to manage multiple complex estimates at different stages of development.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with renewable energy, utility-scale solar, EPC organizations, electrical contracting, or industrial electrical projects.

  • Proficiency with AutoCAD.

  • Working knowledge of the National Electrical Code (NEC).

  • Education in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Technology, Construction Management, or a related technical discipline; equivalent relevant industry experience will also be considered.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means producing estimates that are accurate, complete, timely, and traceable.

You’ll take ownership of your work, identify inconsistencies and risks before they become costly problems, clearly communicate assumptions and technical concerns, and help projects transition smoothly from opportunity through award and execution. You’ll also contribute to improving the tools and processes the Paige Energy team uses to make estimating increasingly efficient and reliable.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary ranging from $80,000 to $90,000 plus annual bonus based on company and individual performance

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options (CDHP and PPO) to get you the coverage you need
  • Robust Financial Security: Company-paid life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, plus options for supplemental critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity plans
  • Generous Time Off: PTO plan with paid holidays, paid parental leave, and paid compassionate care leave to support personal well-being and family needs
  • Wellness & Support Programs: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), wellness incentives, and telehealth access
  • Extras That Matter: Dental and vision plans, FSAs/HSAs with company contributions, pet insurance, legal services, and ID theft protection for peace of mind
  • An employee-centric company that values and truly appreciates our most important asset: You!

About Paige

Paige, a GCG company, has been delivering innovative wire and cable solutions for over 65 years. Serving industries including renewable energy, data communications, industrial applications, irrigation, and more, we are committed to engineering excellence, customer-driven innovation, and high-quality products that help businesses solve complex challenges with tailored solutions.

Built on a foundation of expertise, flexibility, and humility, we are dedicated to solving customer challenges, adapting to their needs, and continuously improving. At Paige, we remove ego from the equation, fostering a collaborative, customer-focused culture that drives long-term growth, innovation, and enduring partnerships.

Join us and be part of a company shaping the future of connectivity.

About GCG

At GCG, our mission is to power, connect, and automate our world. With the responsive DNA of a startup and the size of a global leader, we offer top brands and extensive value-added services that make us an invaluable partner to our customers in multiple industry verticals across the globe.

We are committed to meeting the needs of our customers, while focusing attention on our responsibility to the environment, our associates and the communities we serve.

Our Use of AI in Recruiting

At GCG, we use AI technology to assist with our interviews by automating note-taking, allowing our hiring teams to focus fully on the conversation. This technology supports efficiency and accuracy in capturing candidate insights during interviews but is not used to evaluate resumes. All resume reviews and candidate assessments are conducted directly by our corporate recruiting team and hiring managers to ensure a thoughtful, human-centered approach.

The Wilkinson Firm (TWF) is an enterprise workforce strategy and staffing firm. Two divisions today: HR Advisory for the mental health industry and Premium Hospitality Staffing. Partnership structure (LLC member with profit distributions)

This is a partnership role, not an employment role. You join as an LLC member with a defined membership interest. Cross-division CRO membership lives either at the holding-co level or pro-rata across division LLCs, negotiable based on revenue allocation.

The membership interest tiers are the headline. Tier 3 (3-8%) grants at hire if you clear a 6-month trial against the 5-gate evaluation. Tier 4 (8-15%, true partner level) progresses at month 18-24 with sustained firm-wide revenue performance. Vesting runs four years with a one-year cliff. Zero institutional debt means no forced dilution from future investor rounds, so your membership stays your membership.

Profit distributions flow quarterly, proportional to membership. Direct attribution adds 3-5% override on total firm revenue and 5-10% on revenue you directly sourced. Bonus stack: $25,000 at first $1M ARR milestone, $50,000 at $2.5M ARR, $100,000 at $5M ARR.

Guaranteed monthly distributions are the honest read on cash. We're a startup. Day 1-90 is $0 while you ramp on revenue attribution + membership vesting. Months 3-4, $3,000-$5,000/month activates once first division-wide revenue uplift is measurable. Months 6-12, $5,000-$10,000/month at $750K+ firm-wide attributable revenue. Year 1 OTE at target performance: $100,000-$250,000 cash + membership vesting.

Tax structure is K-1, not W-2. Self-employment tax applies. Talk to your CPA before signing. The founder takes no guaranteed monthly distributions today either. We share the upside as members.

jobs.excerpt: NOTE: This is a remote position; CRS will only consider candidates who are based in countries where we have existing offices.
jobs.description:
NOTE: This is a remote position; CRS will only consider candidates who are based in countries where we have existing offices.

Job Summary

The Supply Chain Management Technical Advisor II will provide technical support, accompaniment, and training to EMPOWER partners in South America to strengthen supply chain and operational preparedness for rapid emergency response.

The Supply Chain Management Technical Advisor II will work with EMPOWER partners to improve their supply chain preparedness and response capacities so that can set up and operate multiple modality supply chains (in kind and CVA) in an expedited manner.

This includes the following five priority focuses:

1) Updated specifications--Adjusting relief item/kit specifications and CVA transfer amounts to match latest technical recommendations, that are appropriate to the context, and which are available/possible in the local market;

2) Strategic sourcing--Exploring local markets to identify best output value suppliers (quality, delivery and price) for key relief items/kits and cash voucher assistance modalities (via financial and mobile service providers);

3) Prepositioned stocks--Establishing prepositioned stocks of key relief items in countries where it is hard to find them locally to the desired specifications (i.e. stored value cards, vouchers, humanitarian grade tarps, light and charge solar lanterns, and water purification tablets/satchels);

4) Open contracts--Setting up indefinite quantity contracts (open contracts/framework agreements) with best suppliers identified for key relief items/kits and CVA modalities; and

5) Continuous improvement—Supporting partners to identify ways they can improve their procurement, inventory management, logistics and distribution processes, tools and capabilities so they can enhance efficiency and responsiveness.

The role will work closely with partners and relevant CRS teams to identify and close priority bottlenecks, test readiness systems, and enable partners to procure, contract, transport, store, and distribute assistance quickly, responsibly, and in compliance with applicable standards.

Roles and Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the multiple modality supply chain set up process in all five target countries in close coordination with partner supply chain teams focusing on the whole supply chain from procurement to inventory management, and then planning for logistics and distributions when responses activated.
  • Make sure that all five priority focuses are executed as intended: updated specifications, strategic sourcing, prepositioned stocks, open contracts, and continuous improvement.
  • Support programming team with market and logistics analysis, hotspot prioritization, stakeholder mapping, and development of a workplan and deliverable calendar.
  • Work with technical leads and partners to establish minimum quality standards, packing guidance, replenishment requirements, quality-control processes, and substitution rules.
  • Validate priority kit contents against local market availability, cultural appropriateness, hazard scenarios, packaging needs, and branding and visibility expectations.
  • Collect and verify market prices and develop country-, hot spot-, remote-area- specific kit costing matrices that account for transport, handling, storage, customs or importation, last-mile delivery, supplier lead times, and other key cost drivers.
  • Map, assess, conduct due diligence on, and support prequalification of suppliers, transporters, warehouse providers, packaging providers, and other service providers, including backup suppliers and alternative sourcing options for key items.
  • Develop and maintain vendor databases and prequalified vendor lists organized by country, hotspot, sector, commodity group, and service type, with clear ownership, review frequency, renewal dates, and documentation requirements.
  • Support partners and relevant CRS functions to prepare or update open contracts, framework agreements, standby supplier agreements, emergency procurement templates, and associated contracting-readiness files.
  • Map and assess financial and mobile service providers for cash and voucher assistance, including geographic coverage, transfer modalities, fees, liquidity, surge capacity, compliance, data protection, reporting capacity, and humanitarian experience.
  • Support financial and mobile service provider contracting readiness and partner protocols for activation, secure data transfer, reconciliation, complaints handling, and failed-payment procedures.
  • Assess partner procurement, contracting, warehousing, inventory management, transport, distribution, documentation, segregation-of-duties, and quality-assurance processes; facilitate practical improvements to close priority gaps.
  • Provide guidance on warehouse requirements by inventory type, stock security, inventory systems, storage practices, and readiness for safe and orderly in-kind distributions, including relevant manuals and procedures.
  • Map regional land, sea, and air shipping routes and options for partners operating across multiple countries, including arrangements for inter-country movement of relief items where applicable.
  • Develop partner-specific readiness checklists and action plans with defined actions, responsible persons, deadlines, support needs, approvals, compliance risks, contingency arrangements, escalation points, and maintenance responsibilities.

Since our founding in 1924, we've cut cardiovascular disease deaths in half, but there is still so much more to do. To overcome today’s biggest health challenges and accelerate this progress, we need passionate individuals like you. Join our movement, be part of the progress, and help ensure a healthier future for all. You matter, and so does the impact you can make with us.

The American Heart Association (Association) has an excellent opportunity for a Senior Communications Manager - Science Media Relations.

This is a position that can be home-based and a flexible location.

The Association offers many resources to help you maintain work-life harmonization through your changing needs and life situations. To help you be successful, you will have access to Heart U, our award-winning corporate university, as well as additional training and support, locally.

#TheAHALife is more than a company culture; it is our way of life. It embodies our commitment to work-life harmonization and is guided by our core values where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Discover why you will Be Seen. Be Heard. Be Valued at the American Heart Association by following us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and at heart.jobs.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for the implementation of multi-year strategic communication plans supporting and promoting scientific manuscripts published in the American Heart Association’s 14 peer-reviewed scientific and medical journals, abstracts presented at the Association’s scientific meetings and the Association’s clinical care guidelines, scientific statements and advisories to the media and the public. Responsible for developing appropriate resources and translating the science for the media and the public, to reinforce the Association’s role as a leading voice in cardiovascular and brain health science and care, and the Association’s mission and impact goals. Responsible for securing earned media coverage, establishing and cultivating relationships with journalists, and supporting our science leaders and research authors of scientific manuscripts and abstracts presenting at our scientific meetings or publishing in our scientific journals, and other projects as assigned.

Essential Job Duties:

  • Review manuscripts accepted for publication in our scientific journals and abstracts accepted for presentation at our scientific meetings.
  • Develop news releases or other news materials, media pitches, and multi-media assets to promote scientific research featured in abstracts and manuscripts, published in the American Heart Association’s 14 peer-reviewed scientific journals and/or presented at any of the Association’s 7 scientific meetings, or to promote the Association’s clinical care guidelines, scientific statements, and advisories.
  • Collaborate with team members to review and select abstracts to promote, provide peer edits for colleagues’ news releases, develop talking points, key messages for research authors and/or experts for commentary and perspective.
  • Lead development of news kits for one or more of our scientific meetings, which includes review and selection of abstracts for promotion; developing detailed news releases that include expert quotes/perspectives as well as research author perspectives,; producing or collaborating with other teams for all related news materials, which may include video interviews, talking points, key messages, FAQs and/or infographics.
  • Work with the Senior Director and the Vice President on the traditional and social media, as well as Association-owned channels.
  • Develop strategic communications plans, media opportunities and relationships to promote the Association’s role as a thought leader in cardiovascular science and brain health, including the Association’s clinical care guidelines, scientific statements and advisories.
  • Monitor the traditional media and social media landscape to ensure the Association can respond appropriately to breaking news related to heart and brain health and latest evidence-based recommendations to mitigate risk, as well efforts to protect the Association’s reputation and integrity.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including Science and Medicine, Science Operations, Scientific Publishing, Science Marketing, Social Media Marketing, Health and Science Programs, and Enterprise-Wide Mobilization teams, and external collaborators to optimize communications reach and amplify the Association’s life-saving mission among volunteers, internal stakeholders, and external partners.
  • Supervise up to 2 members of the Science Media Relations team in close collaboration with the Senior Director.
  • Lead or support other Communications initiatives as applicable and relevant.
  • Mentor and coach Science Media Relations team members and internal and external collaborators.

Want to help get your resume to the top? Take a look at the experience we require:

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Communications or equivalent experience.
  • Five (5) years of excellent writing and editing skills, translating scientific research for the public, and solid knowledge of AP Style.
  • Five (5) years of managing the submission of press, promotional, or related content, building relationships with journalists, and securing quality earned media coverage.
  • Five (5) years of proficient computer skills, including all Microsoft Office programs, especially Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.
  • Five (5) years of project management experience, including managing multiple projects concurrently.
  • Five (5) years of demonstrated ability to work under tight deadlines, while facing competing demands and priorities for multiple projects.
  • Ability to travel up to 10%-15% local and overnight stay.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Eight (8) years of relevant experience.
  • At least three (3) years of experience in a successful supervisory role.
  • Proven ability to review and translate scientific abstracts and manuscripts; develop newsworthy ideas and approaches; write and pitch stories to media outlets; manage media interviews and produce news conferences, including prepping research authors and experts; craft talking points and/or key messages; foster collaborative relationships with reporters that position the organization as a primary resource for their stories.
  • Portfolio demonstrating successful expertise in developing and implementing multi-faceted media strategies that generate visibility for scientific publications, journals, and scientific meetings.

Compensation & Benefits

Salary minimum to the midpoint of the range is $86,000.00 to $102,000.00. Pay is commensurate with experience; geographic differentials may apply to the pay range. The American Heart Association reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range.

The American Heart Association invests in its people. Here are the main components of our total rewards package. Visit Rewards & Benefits to see more details.

  • Compensation – Our goal is to ensure you have a competitive base salary. That’s why we regularly review the market value of jobs and make adjustments, as needed.
  • Performance and Recognition – You are rewarded for achieving success through annual salary planning and incentive programs; eligibility for an incentive program is based on the type of position.
  • Benefits – We offer a wide array of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance, along with a robust retirement program that includes an employer match and automatic contribution. As a mark of our commitment to employee well-being, we also offer an employee assistance program, employee wellness program and telemedicine, and medical consultation.
  • Professional Development – You can join one of our many Employee Resource Groups (ERG) or be a mentor/mentee in our professional mentoring program. Heart U is the Association’s national online university, with more than 100,000 resources designed to meet your needs and busy schedule.
  • Work-Life Harmonization – The Association offers Paid Time Off (PTO) at a minimum of 16 days per year for new employees. The number of days will increase based on seniority level. You will also have a total of 12 paid holidays off each year, which includes several days off at the end of the year.
  • Tuition Assistance - We support the career development of all employees. This program provides financial assistance to employees who wish to further their education and career in relation to their current duties and responsibilities, or for potential future positions in the organization.

The American Heart Association’s 2028 Goal: Building on over 100 years of trusted leadership in cardiovascular and brain health, by 2028 the Association will drive breakthroughs and implement proven solutions in science, policy, and care for healthier people and communities. The greatest discoveries in health must reach everyone where they are.

At American Heart Association | American Stroke Association, our mission is to be a relentless force for a world of longer, healthier lives, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, religion, age, language, sexual orientation, national origin and physical or cognitive abilities.This position not a match with your skills? Business Development Manager – Fenestration & Screen Systems

Location: Remote, United States; with convenient access to a major commercial airport / Nationwide travel

Compensation: Competitive base salary plus performance-based incentive | Company-paid health insurance. 401(k) retirement plan with competitive employer match. 20 days of paid time off, plus 11 paid company holidays.

About the Role

ETTLIN Smart Textiles Inc. is seeking an experienced Business Development Manager to drive the continued growth of Transpatec®, its premium insect screen fabric, in the U.S. market. Learn more about ETTLIN Smart Textiles at:

This opportunity is well suited for a commercially driven professional with experience in insect screening, screen systems, fenestration, shading/sun protection, or a closely related segment of the window and door industry who understands the market, enjoys developing new customer relationships, and is comfortable building business across a nationwide territory.

ETTLIN established its U.S. subsidiary earlier this year and has already developed initial customer relationships and a growing pipeline of market opportunities. CRM and sales processes, U.S.-based support, product samples, and logistics resources are in place to support customer development across the market. The Business Development Manager will now take ownership of the next phase of U.S. market development, with a focus on expanding the customer and partner base and converting market opportunities into sustainable, recurring business.

As ETTLIN's first dedicated U.S. business development professional, this position will report directly to the COO and offers a high degree of visibility, ownership, and direct access to the company's leadership team. As the U.S. business grows, the successful candidate will have the opportunity to take on broader commercial responsibilities and play an increasingly important role in shaping ETTLIN's U.S. organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop new business opportunities for Transpatec® across the U.S. market
  • Identify and develop relationships with insect screen system providers, screen fabricators, fenestration distributors, franchise and multi-location screen installation networks, and other strategic channel partners
  • Build relationships with companies that have established access to professional installers, dealers, and end customers within the residential fenestration and screening market
  • Develop selected opportunities with window and door manufacturers, screen frame manufacturers, and fenestration component suppliers
  • Guide prospective customers from initial product introduction and sampling through commercial orders and recurring business
  • Represent ETTLIN at customer meetings, relevant industry trade shows, and market events
  • Monitor developments within the U.S. insect screen and fenestration market, including competitor activity, channel structures, customer requirements, and emerging applications

Candidate Profile

  • Relevant B2B sales or business development experience within insect screening, screen systems, fenestration, window and door products, shading/sun protection, or a closely related market
  • Familiarity with the U.S. fenestration and screening industry and its distribution channels
  • Existing relationships with system providers, fabricators, distributors, installation organizations, manufacturers, dealers, or other relevant industry contacts are strongly preferred
  • Proven ability to develop new customers and grow business rather than exclusively manage an established account base
  • Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to engage credibly with business owners, commercial leaders, purchasing teams, and other customer stakeholders
  • A self-directed and entrepreneurial working style, combined with the ability to collaborate effectively with an international team
  • Commercial judgment and the ability to communicate the value of a differentiated technical product
  • Strong presentation, communication, and negotiation skills
  • Comfort using CRM systems; HubSpot experience is a plus
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly throughout the United States
  • German language skills are a plus, but not required

About the Comnany

ETTLIN Smart Textiles is part of the ETTLIN Group, a long-established German textile manufacturer with roots dating back to 1836.

The group combines extensive textile manufacturing expertise with the development of innovative and technical textile solutions for a variety of industries and applications.

For its U.S. expansion, ETTLIN has established ETTLIN Smart Textiles Inc. and developed the infrastructure required to support continued market growth, including CRM and sales processes, marketing and sales materials, market intelligence, product support, and an existing U.S.-based support structure.

The Business Development Manager will work closely with ETTLIN's product specialists and management team in Germany and will receive comprehensive product and company training.

About the job: Lead Consultant BI/A
Schedule: 5pm-2am
Due to logistical reasons, we can only accept Philippine-based applicants.

Job Overview

Power BI's basic functionality is rooted in having good quality data. We are looking for lead consultants who specialize in Power BI with a focus on data. You must have advanced knowledge of Power BI and its data components, including PowerQuery/M, DAX, and dimensional modeling, with knowledge and experience in basic report design. Having a working knowledge of conventional SQL Server (data warehouse design, SSIS, and SSRS) and DirectQuery is helpful. You will also need to understand Power BI license models and be able to work with customers to help them achieve the most optimal licensing model for their business needs. You must have experience using the Databricks platform to develop, implement, and optimize data pipelines and workflows. You must have strong communication skills that allow you to regularly deal with clients and their staff, as well as with specialists from related fields, including database developers and software engineers. Your outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills and good grasp of both the technical and business side of business intelligence, and your ability to always keep up to date with the latest updates for Power BI, will make you a good candidate for this role. If you are an individual who is highly interested in using Power BI technologies with a focus on data, and you work well with customers, you may be who we are looking for.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct customer discovery meetings to determine reporting requirements
  • Understand and work with customer on Power BI Licensing, and understand the limits/advantages of each licensing platform
  • Create well-performing star schema data models for use with Power BI, including proper columns and measures
  • Creating Power BI solutions for customers, including importing data from multiple sources, building reports dashboards, and creating appropriate data elements using DAX and source queries
  • Guide customers on deploying Power BI solutions to the Power BI service (Gateways, DirectQuery, Dataflows, Data Updates)

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer, engineering, data science or a related field; or equivalent work experience
  • 5+ years working with data and business intelligence solutions on the Microsoft tool stack for Intelligence (SSRS, Power BI, or PowerPivot (Excel) or PerformancePoint), or other vendor Business Intelligence tools (Business Objects, MicroStrategy, Qlik, SAP)
  • Working knowledge of TSQL, data modeling, reporting using Power BI or other Microsoft tools
  • Experience creating complete Power BI report solutions based on business questions with linked content, drilldowns, and nested parameters
  • Dynamic measure designs using advanced DAX techniques
  • Knowledge of data mashups and transformations using Power Query/M language
  • Utilize the Databricks platform to develop, implement, and optimize data pipelines and workflows.
  • Ability to report visual choices and visual interactions
  • Design, develop and implement user interfaces to ensure ease of use and minimal knowledge by the functional work group that will be using the database
  • Ability to gather requirements and conduct focus groups to determine the processes needed to assist and grow the business

Professional Skills:

  • Eagerness to contribute in a team-oriented environment
  • Excellent communication (written and oral) and interpersonal skills for both technical and non-technical teams
  • Passionate about learning new technologies
  • Analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to use technology to solve business problems
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment

Additional Preferred Experience:

  • Power BI tenant and workspace management to support development, testing and deployment
  • Experience with analytics and custom visualizations for Power BI using Python, R
  • Advanced SQL, including some query tuning
  • Experience in the identification of data quality
  • Experience deploying Power BI solutions to the Power BI Report Server (on-premises)
  • Experience deploying Power BI solutions using Power BI Embedded
  • Deploying cloud-based solutions using Microsoft Azure data services, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, and Azure SQL DB

About SafeLease

At SafeLease, we're rethinking how P&C insurance is sold in an age of technological change. We believe the industry's biggest inefficiencies aren't technical problems — they're structural ones. And we're building the team to tackle them.

SafeLease is a profitable insurance business that designs, underwrites, and distributes specialty coverage for commercial property owners and their tenants. Most insurance companies either distribute products or bear the risk — we do both. jobs.title: Assigning Editor: Social & Viral News
jobs.excerpt: Assigning Editor: Social & Viral NewsAbout The Mary Sue and We Got This CoveredThe Mary Sue and We Got This Covered are looking for a highly skilled and motivated assigning editor to take our story sourcing, pitching, and article curation to the next level, with a focus on social-first stories and syndicated news.
jobs.description:
Assigning Editor: Social & Viral News

About The Mary Sue and We Got This Covered

The Mary Sue and We Got This Covered are looking for a highly skilled and motivated assigning editor to take our story sourcing, pitching, and article curation to the next level, with a focus on social-first stories and syndicated news.

We cover everything from major political news to the latest celebrity drama and the week’s biggest streaming hits. We also tell real stories about real people, like an everyday post on social media that hasn't yet caught anyone else's attention. This variety is the key to our success, and the right candidate should be comfortable sourcing and pitching engaging stories from all corners of the internet as well as major mainstream news.

We aim to share stories with our audience that really get them thinking, talking, and sharing them organically rather than relying on traditional SEO. We want someone who is excited about doing things a little differently and has a hunger for finding the next big story.

About The Role

As the Assigning Editor, you will be in charge of the first, and one of the most crucial, steps when it comes to formulating an engaging or thought-provoking article. You’ll lead story sourcing and pitching for our social and viral news desk across multiple brands and spend much of your day digging into the major news stories that people really care about or on TikTok (as well as Reddit and other social media platforms), spotting posts and conversations that have the makings of a big story. To excel, you’ll have a natural ability to spot the story in something that others would scroll straight past and know how to frame it so it reaches a wide audience.

This is a fast-paced, high-volume role, which will best fit someone who is comfortable pitching a large number of stories every day while using data (and natural instinct) to inform decisions over time.

What You'll Do

  • Keep abreast of major world events, the latest news in the world of entertainment, and understand how to frame these topics in new and interesting ways that will resonate with our audiences
  • Monitor TikTok and other social platforms every day to find stories, ideally before other publishers do
  • Write clear pitches and context to give writers everything they need before starting on an article
  • Assign stories to staff and freelance writers
  • Frame stories and headlines for syndication and social platforms like MSN, Facebook, and SmartNews
  • Track performance and use data to refine your pitches
  • Build and document discovery workflows, so writers and other editors can become stronger pitchers
  • Verify that stories are accurate, credit creators properly, and treat the people in our stories fairly
  • Work with the wider editorial team to spot stories that deserve extra attention, follow-ups, or investigation

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as an assigning, commissioning, news, trending, or social editor in a fast-moving digital media environment (or extensive experience as a self-pitching writer)
  • A genuine love for the weird and wonderful worlds of TikTok and social culture, with a strong instinct for what people will want to read and a passion for exploring new niches
  • Syndication and/or social media experience is a strong plus
  • Excellent, compelling headline writing without being misleading
  • Comfortable working with traffic data and using it to guide editorial decisions
  • An ability to work in a fast-paced, high-volume pitching environment
  • A strong understanding of ethical journalism
  • A strong understanding of US culture and audiences

Think you can spot the next big story before anyone else? Please send us your resume, along with a cover letter that tells us who you are and what makes you a good fit for this role. We'd also love to see three social posts or stories you've come across recently that you think would make a great article, with a headline for each and a line on why you picked it.

Equal Opportunities

The Mary Sue and We Got This Covered are committed to being inclusive and welcoming places to work. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, national origin, age, disability, religion, gender identity and expression, and sexual orientation. LGBTQI+ candidates are warmly welcomed and encouraged to apply.

About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced SeniorPhysician Executive to join our Solution Design organization. As a strategic partner within the commercial team, you will provide expert clinical insights, support the evaluation of Abridge’s ambient solutions, and act as the clinical voice and advocate during customer interactions. Leveraging your clinical background and technological expertise, you will bridge the gap between clinical practice and technology implementation, ensuring our solutions effectively address real-world challenges. This role will help articulate and translate the value of Abridge’s solutions clearly and effectively to senior clinical and executive leadership.

  • Clinical Expertise and Advocacy: Serve as a clinical resource supporting sales and partner success teams by demonstrating how Abridge’s ambient solutions enhance clinical workflows and patient outcomes.

  • Strategic Commercial Support: Partner closely with commercial teams during demos, customer presentations, and strategic engagements, providing clinical credibility and subject matter expertise to executive-level audiences.

The Opportunity

We are building a high-velocity, performance-driven growth engine for premium health and wellness products within competitive and regulated categories. We are looking for a practitioner—not a passive coordinator—to own the growth and optimization of our affiliate acquisition program.

This role sits at the intersection of Partner Management and Media Buying. You aren't just sending emails; you are strategically building a resilient acquisition infrastructure across Meta, Google, TikTok, and alternative sources like ExoClick and TrafficJunky. You must understand the "both sides" of the equation: how to recruit elite traffic partners and how paid acquisition mechanics actually work in high-scrutiny environments.

Core Responsibilities:

1. Program Engineering & Scaling

  • Direct Recruitment: Identify, onboard, and activate high-value affiliates, media buyers, and partner networks. You will lead cold outreach and negotiate complex commercial terms.
  • Alternative Traffic Expansion: Diversify acquisition beyond mainstream platforms into native, push, and high-volume environments (ExoClick, TrafficJunky, etc.).
  • Deal Structuring: Align payout terms (CPA/CPL/RevShare) with internal margin goals, approval rates, and LTV targets.

2. Technical & Funnel Optimization

  • Cross-Functional Sync: Collaborate with internal creative and dev teams to launch and test new advertorials, VSLs, and quiz funnels.
  • Tracking & Attribution: Ensure 100% accuracy in server-side tracking, postbacks, and pixels using tools like Voluum, RedTrack, or Everflow.
  • Infrastructure Resilience: Build and maintain account/domain infrastructure to reduce single points of failure while staying compliant with platform rules.

3. Quality Control & Compliance

  • Traffic Auditing: Continuously monitor lead quality, refund rates, and chargeback signals. You are the first line of defense against fraud.
  • Regulated Scaling: Work with the Legal/Compliance team to scale aggressively but responsibly within health-claim guidelines.
  • SOP Development: Create the "Playbook" for affiliate onboarding, fraud checks, and creative approvals.

Required Experience & Qualifications:

  • Industry Expertise: 4+ years in Affiliate/Performance Marketing, specifically within Nutra, Supplements, Beauty, or Regulated Health.
  • Media Buying Literacy: Deep understanding of Meta, Google, and TikTok ad policies, creative packaging, and account health.
  • The "Grey" Landscape: Proven experience operating in high-scrutiny environments (handling policy sensitivity, review delays, and asset risk).
  • Data Mastery: Expert-level Google Sheets/Excel skills. You must be able to convert raw performance data into decisive action fast.
  • Commercial Drive: Strong negotiation skills with a track record of closing deals and maintaining long-term partner relationships.
  • Language: Professional-level written and verbal English is mandatory.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience scaling Nutra offers to $1M+ monthly revenue.
  • Experience with international/multilingual funnels and global geos.
  • Familiarity with CRM data (LTV, repeat purchase behavior) beyond the initial conversion.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • Volume: Active, qualified affiliates and total revenue contribution.
  • Efficiency: CPA, blended CAC, and ROAS by partner.
  • Quality: Lead-to-sale conversion rates, refund/chargeback rates, and approval volume.
  • Diversity: Reduction of revenue concentration risk across the partner mix.

Why Us?

  • Competitive Compensation: Monthly salary + performance-based bonus scheme.
  • Flexibility: Remote-first culture or a hybrid office in Cancun.
  • Growth: A data-driven environment with a clear path to leadership for those who take total ownership of their numbers.

Engagement type: Independent consultant, 1099 hourly.
Rate range: $100 - $500 per hour, based on experience and scope (three-tier band detailed below).
Time commitment: Part-time or fractional, scales with pipeline (typically 10-40 hrs/week).
Location: Remote with quarterly DC travel preferred.
Reports to: GovCon Division Lead.

A note from the founder

TWF has built the scaffolding for federal work. MBE certification, SAM.gov registration, two operational divisions ready to serve federal contracts, a credentialed bench, and signed commercial customers proving the operating model. What is missing is the capture function. This engagement is for the operator who knows how to walk a federal opportunity from first signal through awarded contract, and who wants to build that function inside a firm where it does not exist yet.

What is already built

The Wilkinson Firm is a workforce strategy and staffing firm headquartered across NC and Atlanta. We launched in April 2025 and are now in Year 2 of operations. Two operational divisions today (HR Advisory for the mental health industry, Premium Hospitality and Event Staffing). Government Contracting division being formally stood up this quarter. Three active staffing contracts in delivery. FY26 trajectory $425-525K. Zero loans, zero institutional debt. Defined path to $5M+ over the next 24 months.

Federal-relevant scaffolding:[- Two operational divisions ready to serve federal contracts in HHS-adjacent verticals (VA mental health programs, DoD behavioral health support, HHS workforce IDIQs) and hospitality (federal lodging, on-base food service, training facility F&B).

What you own

  • Federal opportunity identification and qualification across SAM.gov, GSA Schedules, agency forecasts, and prime/sub channels
  • Capture-to-proposal lifecycle: opportunity assessment, teaming strategy, technical and price strategy, color-team reviews, submission readiness
  • Capture playbook documentation: pursuit criteria, gate reviews, win themes, ghosting strategy, competitive analysis
  • Prime and sub partner relationships and government POC management
  • Set-aside strategy and certification work (8(a), HUBZone, WOSB, SDVOSB) in coordination with the GovCon Division Lead
  • Pipeline visibility and reporting to firm leadership
  • Coaching the Proposal Manager and Federal Account Executive seats as they come online

Engagement structure

Hourly consulting rate, three tiers calibrated to experience and scope:

  • Foundational ($100-200/hr): Capture managers with 5-8 years experience, ramping into a director role
  • Director ($200-350/hr): Established capture directors with documented win history on $1M+ contracts
  • Principal ($350-500/hr): Senior capture principals with multi-million-dollar award history and Tier 1 prime experience

Engagement is hourly. Time commitment scales with pipeline activity, typically 10-40 hours per week. Win-based bonus stack negotiable on top of hourly rate for awarded contracts the engagement materially drove.

Success milestones

  • Day 30: Capture playbook drafted. Pursuit gate criteria documented. Initial pipeline of 10+ qualified opportunities.
  • Day 90: 2-4 active captures in formal pursuit. First teaming agreements signed. Pipeline value $1M+.
  • Day 180: 2-4 proposals submitted. First award or shortlist position. Win rate baseline established.

Who you are

  • 7-15 years in federal capture, proposal management, or BD for small to mid-size GovCon firms
  • Documented track record capturing $1M+ federal contracts
  • Shipley-trained or equivalent. SAM.gov fluent. Comfortable with FAR/DFARS terminology
  • Familiar with small business set-asides and the certification lifecycle
  • Past performance citations in workforce, HHS-adjacent, hospitality, or staffing services preferred
  • Comfortable building a function from scratch inside a founder-led firm
  • Located in DC, NC, GA, or willing to travel to DC quarterly

Bonus points

  • Prior role at a Tier 1 GovCon prime or boutique capture firm
  • Existing relationships at DoD, VA, HHS, GSA, or DHS
  • APMP credential
  • Track record of managed HUBZone or 8(a) certifications

How we will get to know each other

  1. Initial 30-minute fit conversation with the GovCon Division Lead
  2. Working session: walk through a real federal opportunity or proposal scenario we are actively considering
  3. Reference checks (3+ professional references) and work history verification
  4. Engagement letter, scope of work, and rate confirmation
  5. Kickoff within 7 days of signed engagement

2-4 weeks first conversation to active engagement.

What we believe

Trust before revenue. Mission before money. Real seats, real upside. We build durable federal relationships through earned credibility. We win together. We pay people in real numbers, not pizza parties. We are building something great and we want partners who feel the same.

Application tips

  1. Visit , ,
  2. Find The Wilkinson Firm on LinkedIn
  3. In your cover note, answer two questions: (1) what kind of GovCon engagement model works best for you (project-based, retained hours, hybrid), and (2) one example of a federal pursuit, proposal, or account you would point to as your strongest reference work

What to expect from us

  • Reply within 48 hours
  • First-round conversation within 7 days of qualification
  • Full process: 2-4 weeks
  • We tell you yes or no. We do not ghost.

jobs.excerpt: The Wilkinson Firm (TWF) is an enterprise workforce strategy and solutions company with two divisions: Hospitality Staffing and HR Advisory (behavioral health and HHS focus).
jobs.description:
The Wilkinson Firm (TWF) is an enterprise workforce strategy and solutions company with two divisions: Hospitality Staffing and HR Advisory (behavioral health and HHS focus). Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia and NC, respectively. Three active staffing contracts today; the next 24 months are about building and expanding a real book across the Hospitality Staffing industry.

About this role

TWF's Hospitality Staffing division is in 0-to-1 mode. You're not running a machine someone else built. You're the first SDR. You'll build the outbound motion with the founder, and if you're the right person, you become a partner in this division long-term.

The partner upside

  • TWF Earned Equity Ladder: Tier 2 (1-3% equity) eligible at month 6 against the 5-gate evaluation
  • Tier 3 (3-8% equity) progression by month 18 if you continue performing and take on strategic ownership
  • Tier 4 (8-15% equity, true partner level) by month 36 for the right person
  • Recurring revenue share: 1-5% of net profit on staffing revenue from accounts you sourced, paid quarterly, residual for the life of the account
  • The math: build a book of 20-30 hotel accounts at $50,000 average annualized recurring, your residual stream alone compounds into a meaningful annual income within 24 months independent of base + commission

The pay

  • Base: $0 first 90 days. Modest base ($1,500 to $2,500/month) introduced at month 4 once you've signed your first 2-3 accounts and cash flow supports it
  • Commission: 10% of first-year contract value on every signed account you sourced
  • Recurring revenue share: 1-5% of net profit on recurring staffing revenue from accounts you sourced
  • Bonus stack: $250 per qualified Discovery Call that converts to a proposal, $1,000 per signed account
  • Realistic Y1 total comp at target performance: $35,000 to $85,000 plus residual stream that compounds
  • Equity: see "The partner upside" above

What this is and isn't

This is:
  • Employee-level-1 on the outbound side of a relationship-led services firm
  • Founder-led with hands-on weekly support during ramp
  • Equity-bearing with a real path to partner-level ownership
  • Relationship and book-of-business work. We close because we earn trust, not because we have a slick demo

This isn't:

  • A mature SDR org with a playbook, dashboards, and an SDR manager above you. You'll help build them
  • A volume-spam motion. Every email goes out personally signed
  • A hand-holding environment. People who need a defined system to operate inside will struggle here

What you'll do

  • Build the outbound playbook for hospitality property accounts
  • Run 40-60 personally-signed cold emails per business day into hotel GMs, Directors of F&B, Banquet Directors, and Catering Directors
  • Send 30-50 LinkedIn Sales Navigator connection requests per week
  • Place 10-20 warm-then-cold dials per day to people who opened or accepted
  • Qualify replies, book Discovery Calls on the founder's calendar, log everything in HubSpot
  • Iterate copy weekly. Document what works so the next SDR has a playbook

Why this role exists

TWF's Hospitality Staffing division has the founder, operational leadership, and three signed contracts in delivery. There is no dedicated outbound motion yet. You're it. If we get the outbound machine right with you, this division becomes the engine of TWF's first $5M in revenue. That's the prize.

What success looks like
  • Day 30: outbound stack stood up, first 100 personally-signed emails sent, first 5 Discovery Calls booked
  • Day 60: 12-20 Discovery Calls booked per month becoming routine
  • Day 90: 8% positive reply rate sustained, first 2-3 accounts signed
  • Day 180: Tier 2 equity grant landed if performance sustained, residual revenue stream starting to compound
  • Day 365: SDR playbook documented, next SDR onboarded against your foundation, Tier 3 equity progression on the table

Who you are

  • 6 months to 3 years in B2B outbound sales (services or hospitality staffing preferred)
  • You've worked in a startup or early-stage environment before, or you know that's the environment you want
  • Comfortable being employee-level-1 on a function. You build the system, not inherit it
  • You log every touch in CRM. If it's not logged, it didn't happen
  • Self-directed. The founder will not check your activity hourly
  • Eastern Time work hours

Bonus points

  • Prior experience selling into hotel F&B, banquet, or catering verticals
  • Existing relationships with regional chambers, NCRLA, GHLA, AAHOA
  • Experience building an outbound motion from scratch at a prior startup
  • HubSpot, Apollo, or Sales Navigator fluency
  • HOW WE WORK:

    - Remote, Eastern Time

    - Async-friendly inside core hours (9am-1pm ET overlap minimum)
    - Weekly 1:1 with founder during ramp
    - Tech stack ready on Day 1: HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Slack
    - You'll partner with the Director of Hospitality Operations on trial conversion follow-through

What we believe

Trust before revenue. Mission before money. Long game. We don't cold-spam. Every email goes out personally signed. We build durable relationships, not flashy logos. We pay people in real upside, not in pizza parties.

Application Tips

1. Visit . Five minutes. Understand the company you'd be building with.

2. Find The Wilkinson Firm on LinkedIn... look around at our social media presence.

3. In your cover note, tell us one thing: what's the first bet you'd make in your first 30 days here, and why?

What to expect from us

- Reply within 48 hours of application

- First-round screen within 7 days

- Full process: 2-3 weeks

- We tell you yes or no. We do not ghost.

About TP

TP is a leading global provider of digital business services. We partner with the world's most prominent brands to optimize operations through advanced technology and sustainable business practices. We offer benefits and tools to help our team members and their families for their financial future. This includes offering competitive 401(K) plans, life insurance, supplemental medical coverage, critical care insurance, pet insurance, FSA plans, and retailer discounts.

Career Growth and Culture

At TP, we prioritize a culture of inclusion and diversity where every employee feels valued. We provide a platform for limitless career advancement, fostering an environment where ambition and high performance lead to long-term success.

TP is committed to supporting those who serve. We welcome applications from active-duty service members, veterans, and military families.

Equal Opportunity Employer

TP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

If you require reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact us at 877-877-3944 or contact us here. Please note, this contact channel is not a means to apply for or inquire about a position and we are unable to respond to non-accommodation-related requests.

Purpose

We’re seeking a dynamic Integrated Account-Based Marketing (ABM) Manager to lead and execute targeted, multichannel campaigns that drive pipeline growth and revenue for our Government Services line of business, serving Federal civilian, defense, and State, Local, and Education (SLED) buyers. The role will also support TP’s Collections business, developing integrated ABM marketing programs targeting organizations that manage first-party collections and/or outsource third-party collections, including financial services, healthcare, utilities, telecommunications, government and other industries with significant receivables operations.

Reporting to the Director of Integrated ABM Marketing, you will manage 1:1, 1:Few, and 1:Many ABM campaigns, collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Operations teams, SDRs, and other Marketing teams. This role is pivotal in creating personalized, data-driven engagement with high-value accounts and buying committees across both markets.

For Government Services, you will develop integrated campaigns around offerings including citizen experience, data services, professional services, technology and security services, and business process outsourcing. You will translate Federal and SLED procurement cycles, contract vehicles, budget timing, and partner motions into actionable marketing strategies.

Engagement type: Independent consultant, 1099 hourly.

A note from the founder

TWF has built the scaffolding for federal work. MBE certification, SAM.gov registration, two operational divisions ready to serve federal contracts, a credentialed bench, and signed commercial customers proving the operating model. What is missing is the capture function. This engagement is for the operator who knows how to walk a federal opportunity from first signal through awarded contract, and who wants to build that function inside a firm where it does not exist yet.

What is already built

The Wilkinson Firm is a workforce strategy and staffing firm headquartered across NC and Atlanta. We launched in April 2025 and are now in Year 2 of operations. Two operational divisions today (HR Advisory for the mental health industry, Premium Hospitality and Event Staffing). Government Contracting division being formally stood up this quarter. Three active staffing contracts in delivery. FY26 trajectory $425-525K. Zero loans, zero institutional debt. Defined path to $5M+ over the next 24 months.

Federal-relevant scaffolding:[- Two operational divisions ready to serve federal contracts in HHS-adjacent verticals (VA mental health programs, DoD behavioral health support, HHS workforce IDIQs) and hospitality (federal lodging, on-base food service, training facility F&B).
