You’ll write the email, build the flow, read the dashboard, fix the landing page, and brief the ad—sometimes all in the same day.

You’re comfortable across the channel mix, technical enough to build your own automations, and curious enough to learn what you haven’t done before. You know when to dig into the data and when to ship a first version and learn from it.

Your first priority will be getting our lifecycle and CRM foundations working well: auditing existing flows, establishing a reliable baseline, and shipping the fixes with the highest revenue impact. From there, you’ll take on broader conversion ownership—from first site visit to booked call, attended call, deposit, and subscription.

You’ll work closely with our VP of Growth Marketing, to turn ideas into better experiences for families and measurable growth for Sage Haus.

You’re a Great Fit If…

  • You’ve owned a full demand funnel end to end—not just one channel inside it—and can talk through what you built, what you changed, and what happened next.
  • You build your own automations and flows. You’re comfortable in tools like Make, Zapier, Flodesk, Klaviyo, or ActiveCampaign, and you’re willing to learn whatever helps you get the job done.
  • You can write the email, build the reminder sequence, and figure out why people are booking calls but not showing up.
  • You’re comfortable getting under the hood of a landing page, form, or booking flow, spotting friction, and shipping a fix.
  • You trust data over instinct. You can pull the number, chart it, explain what it means, and change the plan when the results tell you to.
  • You use AI to move faster, solve problems, and learn new skills. For us, it’s a workflow tool—not a replacement for thoughtful, human content.
  • You’d rather ship a version 1 today than perfect a version 3 in a quarter. You know how to prioritize, test, learn, and keep moving.
  • You care about the families behind the funnel. You want the experience to feel clear, helpful, and personal from the first click onward.

Bonus: You’ve worked in a two-sided marketplace, subscription/app business, or household services. You’re comfortable connecting the dots across paid media, sales, content, and SEO.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $100,000–$130,000 annually on a full-time-equivalent basis, depending on experience and qualifications.

We’re looking for someone who can grow with Sage Haus. This role is intended to be full-time, but we’re open to starting part-time and building toward full-time together if that makes the transition easier. We’ll agree on hours, prorated compensation, and a ramp-up timeline before you begin.

Schedule & Work Environment

  • Fully remote: Work where you do your best work.
  • 30–40 hours per week: A flexible schedule, with agreed time together for team meetings and collaboration.
  • Room to ramp up: We’re open to an initial part-time schedule with a clear path to full-time.
  • Ownership and collaboration: You’ll have room to run with your work, alongside a team that shares ideas, solves problems, and keeps families at the center.

Interview Process

We want to get to know how you think, what you’ve built, and what you’re looking for next—and give you a chance to get to know us, too. Here’s what you can expect:

  1. A quick introduction — 15 minutes. We’ll talk about your background, what drew you to Sage Haus, and practical details like availability and compensation.
  2. A short technical exercise. A chance to show how you approach the kind of work you’d do here. We’ll share clear instructions and the expected time commitment in advance.
  3. A conversation with our leadership team — 20–30 minutes. We’ll dig into your experience, how you work with others, and how you tackle a problem when the answer isn’t obvious.
  4. A final conversation with Nelson, our VP of Growth Marketing. We’ll talk through your approach, what you’d take on first, and any remaining questions on either side before we make a hiring decision.

How to Apply

If you’re passionate about helping families, enjoy connecting people, and are excited about the Sage Haus mission, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter explaining why you’d be a great fit for this role.

Salary: $100,000 – $130,000 / year

Independent Music Artist – Early Platform Programme

Location: Remote / Global
Engagement: Independent Artist Programme
Earnings: Direct artist earnings through platform participation
Initial Cohort: Limited to approximately 100 artists

Our client, an innovative music technology start-up, is seeking ambitious independent music artists to join the first cohort of artists on its new music and fan-engagement platform.

This opportunity is specifically designed for artists who consider their music to be a serious part of their career and want to build sustainable income from their creativity.

The platform has been built around a simple belief:

Artists should not need millions of streams before their music starts generating meaningful income.

Instead of relying solely on passive streaming, the platform enables artists to build direct relationships with the people who genuinely support their work and monetise that community.

You do not need thousands of followers to be considered. You do, however, need a minimum of 10 genuine supporters who you reasonably believe would actively support your music if they were given the opportunity to support you directly.

These could be existing fans, friends, family or people already following your musical journey.

As an example, 100 genuine supporters on our client's platform could generate an artist at least US$400 per month in recurring income.

For many independent artists, significantly larger streaming audiences currently generate far less.

The question is therefore not simply:

How many people listen to my music?

It is:

How many people genuinely support me as an artist?

Our client is initially looking to select approximately 100 independent artists to join the platform ahead of its wider rollout.

Mandatory Application Questions

All questions must be answered. Applications submitted without the requested information may be automatically rejected.

  1. Are you currently an independent music artist, and have you previously released original music publicly?
    Yes / No
  2. Please provide a link to your Spotify, Apple Music or other main artist profile.
  3. Approximately how many monthly listeners do you currently have?
  4. Please provide links to your main artist social media profiles and state approximately how many followers you have.
  5. Do you have a minimum of 10 people who you genuinely believe would financially support your music if they had the opportunity to support you directly rather than simply listening through a streaming platform?

    Yes / No

    If yes, approximately how many genuine supporters do you believe you currently have?

  6. Did you earn any income from your music during the last 12 months?
    Yes / No
  7. Approximately how much did you earn from music streaming during the last 12 months?
  8. Roughly how much did you earn in total from your music and music-related social media activity during the last 12 months?

Key Responsibilities

As one of the first artists selected for the platform, you will be expected to:

  • Create and maintain an active artist profile.
  • Upload and showcase your music and relevant artist content.
  • Introduce your existing supporters to the platform.
  • Bring a minimum of 10 genuine supporters onto the platform.
  • Engage regularly with your supporters and build your artist community.
  • Make active use of the platform's artist monetisation tools.
  • Promote your music and platform presence through your existing channels.
  • Explore and use the functionality made available to you.
  • Provide constructive feedback on your experience where requested.
  • Participate in occasional testing, surveys or feedback sessions during the initial rollout.
  • Report technical or user-experience issues where identified.
  • Treat your artist presence, audience and earning opportunities professionally.
  • Where appropriate, introduce other credible independent artists within your network who may also benefit from joining the platform.

Requirements

To be considered, you should:

  • Be an independent music artist actively pursuing or developing a career in music.
  • Have previously created, recorded or released original music.
  • Have music available online that we can review.
  • Have an existing audience or community, even if that audience is currently small.
  • Have a minimum of 10 genuine supporters who you reasonably believe would actively support your music through the platform.
  • Be willing to introduce those supporters to the platform.
  • Be comfortable engaging directly with your audience rather than relying solely on passive streaming.
  • Be willing to actively use the platform and its artist tools.
  • Be reliable, responsive and serious about developing your music career.
  • Be open to providing occasional feedback during the early stages of the platform's rollout.

Ideal Artist Profile

We are not necessarily looking for the artists with the largest following.

An artist with 50,000 followers but little genuine engagement is not automatically more suitable than an artist with 500 followers and 50 people who genuinely care about their music.

We are interested in real audiences, not vanity metrics.

You may currently have 50 monthly listeners or 50,000.

What matters is whether people genuinely care about your music and whether you are prepared to build a direct relationship with them.

You are likely to be someone who:

  • Takes your music career seriously.
  • Is actively building an audience independently.
  • Understands that a successful independent music career requires building a community as well as releasing music.
  • Has people who regularly listen to, comment on, share or otherwise support your work.
  • Is comfortable promoting yourself and communicating directly with your audience.
  • Wants greater control over how you monetise your music.
  • Wants to reduce your reliance on streaming royalties alone.
  • Is prepared to be proactive in developing your career and generating income from your creativity.

Earnings & Artist Benefits

Selected artists will have the opportunity to earn directly through the platform by developing and monetising their supporter community.

As part of the initial artist cohort, you will also receive:

  • Early access to the full platform.
  • Access to all artist functionality available during the initial rollout.
  • Access to certain features that may become paid or premium services for artists joining the platform in future.
  • The opportunity to establish and grow your artist presence before the platform's wider public rollout.
  • The ability to begin generating income directly from your supporters from the outset.
  • Greater direct engagement with the people who support your music.
  • The opportunity to provide feedback that may influence future artist functionality.
  • Access to a growing community of independent artists and music supporters.
  • Priority consideration for artist performance opportunities at the platform's planned 2028/2029 music festival.
  • The opportunity to recommend other credible independent artists from your network for consideration.
  • Remote participation from anywhere in the world.

There is no fee to apply or participate in the initial programme.

Why This Matters

For independent artists, having listeners does not necessarily mean having income.

Our client wants to change that.

Rather than asking artists to spend years chasing enormous streaming numbers before their work generates meaningful returns, the platform has been designed to make smaller, highly engaged communities economically valuable.

If 100 people genuinely value your music enough to support you directly, those 100 people could generate at least US$400 in recurring monthly incomethrough the platform.

That changes the question from:

How do I get millions of streams?

to:

How do I find and build relationships with the people who genuinely value what I create?

Interested?

If you are serious about building your music career, have already started developing an audience and believe you have at least 10 people who would genuinely support you, we would like to hear from you.

Complete all mandatory application questions and provide the requested links to your music and social media profiles.

You don't need a huge audience.

You need a real one.

The Wilkinson Firm is a workforce strategy and staffing firm headquartered across NC and Atlanta. We launched in April 2025 and are now in Year 2 of operations. Federal-relevant scaffolding:[- Two operational divisions ready to serve federal contracts in HHS-adjacent verticals (VA mental health programs, DoD behavioral health support, HHS workforce IDIQs) and hospitality (federal lodging, on-base food service, training facility F&B).

Engagement structure

Hourly consulting rate, three tiers calibrated to experience and scope:

  • Foundational ($100-200/hr): Capture managers with 5-8 years experience, ramping into a director role
  • Director ($200-350/hr): Established capture directors with documented win history on $1M+ contracts
  • Principal ($350-500/hr): Senior capture principals with multi-million-dollar award history and Tier 1 prime experience

Engagement is hourly. Time commitment scales with pipeline activity, typically 10-40 hours per week. Win-based bonus stack negotiable on top of hourly rate for awarded contracts the engagement materially drove.

Success milestones

  • Day 30: Capture playbook drafted. Pursuit gate criteria documented. Initial pipeline of 10+ qualified opportunities.
  • Day 90: 2-4 active captures in formal pursuit. First teaming agreements signed. Pipeline value $1M+.
  • Day 180: 2-4 proposals submitted. First award or shortlist position. Win rate baseline established.

Who you are

  • 7-15 years in federal capture, proposal management, or BD for small to mid-size GovCon firms
  • Documented track record capturing $1M+ federal contracts
  • Shipley-trained or equivalent. SAM.gov fluent. Comfortable with FAR/DFARS terminology
  • Familiar with small business set-asides and the certification lifecycle
  • Past performance citations in workforce, HHS-adjacent, hospitality, or staffing services preferred
  • Comfortable building a function from scratch inside a founder-led firm
  • Located in DC, NC, GA, or willing to travel to DC quarterly

Bonus points

  • Prior role at a Tier 1 GovCon prime or boutique capture firm
  • Existing relationships at DoD, VA, HHS, GSA, or DHS
  • APMP credential
  • Track record of managed HUBZone or 8(a) certifications

How we will get to know each other

  1. Initial 30-minute fit conversation with the GovCon Division Lead
  2. Working session: walk through a real federal opportunity or proposal scenario we are actively considering
  3. Reference checks (3+ professional references) and work history verification
  4. Engagement letter, scope of work, and rate confirmation
  5. Kickoff within 7 days of signed engagement

2-4 weeks first conversation to active engagement.

What we believe

Trust before revenue. Mission before money. Real seats, real upside. We build durable federal relationships through earned credibility. We win together. We pay people in real numbers, not pizza parties. We are building something great and we want partners who feel the same.

Application tips

  1. Visit , ,
  2. Find The Wilkinson Firm on LinkedIn
  3. In your cover note, answer two questions: (1) what kind of GovCon engagement model works best for you (project-based, retained hours, hybrid), and (2) one example of a federal pursuit, proposal, or account you would point to as your strongest reference work

What to expect from us

jobs.excerpt: Our MissionOur mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS.
jobs.description:
Our Mission

Our mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS. Come be part of remarkable.

Overview

How You Can Make a Difference

HealthEquity administers HSAs, FSAs, HRAs, COBRA, and commuter benefits, and our service operations exist to deliver a remarkable experience for our members. The Director, Demand Planning and Worforce Operations leads the consolidated Forecasting and Workforce Management pillar within the Workforce Strategy organization. This leader owns the end-to-end demand-to-delivery cycle: long-range and short-range demand forecasting, capacity and headcount planning, scheduling, and real-time operations across internal teams and BPO partner sites.

This is not a day-to-day execution role. The role is accountable for strategic direction, decision-ready insight for executives, capability-building across the team, and leading the organization through significant platform and operating-model change, including the Verint, Webex, and Amazon Connect migrations, and skill-based routing readiness.

What you will be doing

Forecasting and planning

  • Own the enterprise contact demand forecast (topline, LOB, and interval level) and translate it into capacity plans, hiring plans, and budget inputs for internal and BPO operations.
  • Model and communicate expected outcomes, including service level, ASA, occupancy, and cost to serve, across scenarios; quantify risks and opportunities to support leadership decisions.
  • Lead planning for seasonal peak (Q4/Q1), new partner ramps, and channel expansion (chat, skill-based routing), with clear assumptions and contingency plans.

Workforce management operations

  • Direct scheduling, real-time queue management, and intraday performance across internal and outsourced sites, with tamper-clear audit of adherence and performance data.
  • Drive WFM platform modernization: Verint migration (scheduling, RTQM automation, outcome projection) and readiness for Webex and Amazon Connect capabilities.
  • Expand WFM scope beyond member and client services as automation matures.

Leadership and capability building

  • Deliver executive communication and decision-ready reporting: concise narratives, clear recommendations, and quantified trade-offs rather than raw data.
  • Perform and coach data analysis and interpretation beyond standard reporting, connecting operational signals to financial and member-experience outcomes.
  • Coach and build capability across analysts and managers; operate with a strengths-based, empowerment-oriented leadership style.
  • Lead change management and adoption for new tools, processes, and operating models, including BPO partners.
  • Continuously assess team skill gaps and bring build / train / hire recommendations to leadership.
  • Align the pillar's work to long-term organizational priorities and future-state capability needs, including the lean 2027 operating model.

What success looks like in the first 12 months

  • Forecast accuracy and capacity-plan reliability targets met and reported transparently each cycle.
  • Verint migration adopted with measurable scheduling and RTQM automation gains; Q4 2026 / Q1 2027 peak delivered within service-level and cost commitments.
  • Analyst and manager bench strengthened through coaching, with documented skill-gap assessment and a build / train / hire plan in execution.
  • Executive forums receive decision-ready insight with clear recommendations, reducing escalation and rework.

What you'll need to be successful

Required

  • 10+ years in contact center forecasting, capacity planning, and workforce management, including 5+ years leading leaders in a multi-site environment with BPO partners.
  • Demonstrated ownership of enterprise-level demand forecasting and headcount/budget planning, with strong statistical and scenario-modeling skills.
  • Hands-on depth with WFM and telephony platforms (e.g., Verint or equivalent; Cisco/Webex; cloud contact center platforms) and experience leading platform migrations.
  • Proven executive communication: able to distill complex analysis into clear recommendations for VP+ audiences.
  • Track record of change leadership, coaching, and building high-performing analytical teams.

Preferred

  • Experience in healthcare, benefits administration, or another regulated environment with strict data-handling obligations.
  • Experience with skill-based routing design, chat/digital channel planning, and outsourcing governance.
  • Advanced analytics or data science exposure (SQL, Python/R, or BI platforms) sufficient to lead and quality-check analyst work.

Salary Range

$127000.00 To $160000 / year

Benefits & Perks

The actual compensation offer is determined based on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and work location. This position will be eligible for performance-based incentives and restricted stock units as part of the total compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision
  • HSA contribution and match
  • Dependent care FSA match
  • Uncapped paid time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) match
  • Personal and healthcare financial literacy programs
  • Ongoing education & tuition assistance
  • Gym and fitness reimbursement
  • Wellness program incentives

Onboarding & Travel

This is a remote role, with an in-person onboarding training component. New team members must participate in Trailhead, HealthEquity’s immersive onboarding experience Trailhead is designed to foster meaningful connections, support your integration into the organization, and equip you with a strong understanding of our business. Trailhead participation is a key expectation of this role. Trailhead is held onsite at our headquarters once per quarter. HealthEquity covers all required travel and accommodations.

This role may begin with a virtual, self-paced onboarding experience, followed by a mandatory onsite Trailhead session at a later date.

HealthEquity is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to team members with qualifying disabilities. Should you be selected for this role and require an accommodation, we will put you in touch with our Benefits Team so you can begin the accommodation request process.

Why work with HealthEquity

HealthEquity has a vision that by 2030 we will make HSAs as wide-spread and popular as retirement accounts. We are passionate about providing a solution that allows American families to connect health and wealth. Join us and discover a work experience where the person is valued more than the position. Click here to learn more.

You belong at HealthEquity!

HealthEquity, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to being an employer where no matter your background or identity – you feel welcome and included. We ensure equal opportunity for all applicants and employees without regard to race, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a qualified individual with a disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. HealthEquity is a drug-free workplace. For more information about our EEO policy, or about HealthEquity’s applicant disability accommodation, drug-free-workplace, background check, and E-Verify policies, please visit our Careers page.

HealthEquity uses Microsoft Copilot to transcribe screening interviews between candidates and their direct Talent Partner for note taking and interview summaries. By scheduling a screening interview with us, you consent to Microsoft Copilot’s AI technology recording and transcribing your interview with your Talent Partner. This information will be reviewed for accuracy and then used by HealthEquity to summarize the interview, ensure accuracy, and facilitate our hiring process. We take privacy seriously. You have the option to opt out. If you wish to opt out of this Microsoft Copilot transcription, please notify your Talent Partner in advance of the interview. If we do not receive an opt-out request from you, we will assume that you consent to the use of Microsoft Copilot.

At HealthEquity, our goal is to save and improve lives by empowering healthcare consumers. This shared purpose inspires everything we do, including how we approach hiring. Our process is designed to get to know the real you: your skills, experiences, and potential to make a difference. We value honesty, originality, and the courage to do the right thing, even when it is not the easiest path. Showing up as your authentic self reflects these values and helps us build something truly remarkable together.

For other key parts of our interview process, however, it is important that the ideas, communication, and work you share reflect your own voice, experiences, and thinking. We ask that you participate in our live interviews and complete any assessments without AI assistance unless instructions explicitly indicate otherwise or a specific exception is discussed and approved in advance. This approach ensures fairness, celebrates your individuality, and allows your authentic perspective to shine. We appreciate your understanding and look forward to learning about the unique contributions only you can bring to HealthEquity.

jobs.description:
This opportunity is remote/virtual or hybrid, therefore open to all candidates nationally

Our team and what we'll accomplish together

At TELUS Agriculture & Consumer Goods, our North America Consumer Goods team partners with CPG manufacturers, brands, and distributors to drive competitive advantage at the shelf and in the field. Our sales organization is the engine driving market adoption of our enterprise SaaS platform—and you'll be the operational strategist architecting the processes, data infrastructure, and systems that enable our team to execute at scale.

You'll collaborate with sales leadership and cross-functional teams to optimize sales processes, drive revenue growth, and improve efficiency across our CPG-focused sales motion—supporting everything from funnel hygiene and territory management to CRM administration and sales enablement content. This is a strategic role where operational excellence directly enables revenue acceleration: your work on forecast accuracy, pipeline integrity, and cross-functional alignment will be foundational to our growth trajectory. If you thrive on owning ambiguous, complex problems in matrixed environments and view operational excellence as a strategic competitive advantage, this role offers the scope and impact you're seeking.

What you'll do

Sales Analytics & Pipeline Intelligence

  • Develop and maintain the reporting infrastructure that drives leadership decision-making across the North America sales organization, including MTD/QTD forecasts, product-line funnel analysis, opportunity stage tracking by account and category, and regional performance metrics
  • Conduct diagnostic sales performance analysis to identify conversion bottlenecks, forecast accuracy gaps, and sales cycle inefficiencies; translate findings into actionable recommendations for leadership
  • Build and own rolling forecasts and quota models tied to TELUS CG's product portfolio (Retail Execution, TPM, RGM, Sales Enablement, Shopper Insights) and regional targets
  • Partner with Marketing and Customer Success on reporting that bridges sales pipeline health with downstream operational performance and customer outcomes
  • Provide ad hoc analytical support to cross-functional stakeholders on topics including product roadmap resourcing, engineering pipeline forecasts, and territory capacity planning

CRM Governance & Sales Process Excellence

  • Partner with sales leadership to design and refine the enterprise CPG sales process, accounting for the complexity of longer, multi-stakeholder buying cycles involving manufacturers, brands, retailers, and category management teams; establish best practices in lead management, opportunity tracking, and pipeline optimization specific to CPG/retail buying dynamics
  • Own funnel hygiene practices and controls: ensure closed-won opportunities are reassigned to correct quota-bearing personnel prior to close; audit and monitor this as an ongoing governance function
  • Manage territory assignments and rebalancing across the North America sales team, incorporating new customer and prospect lists from Finance while maintaining equitable territory design
  • Oversee account and prospect ownership in cases of cross-segment overlap; execute account reassignment workflows during rep transitions with impact analysis and seamless handoffs
  • Represent Sales in Salesforce administration and CRM governance: manage renewal/auto-renewal workflows, opportunity team permissions, BDR access controls, and account ownership rules
  • Ensure consistent, accurate CRM data entry and adoption across the sales team; audit and close churn records to maintain data integrity
  • Maintain and audit account trading name/ownership rules to correctly route out-of-scope or misclassified accounts to appropriate placeholders or owners
  • Partner with the CRM platform team on system enhancements, troubleshooting, and support ticket resolution
  • Identify and implement process improvements to increase conversion rates and reduce sales cycle times across the North America region

Sales Enablement & Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Own and improve the structure and accessibility of the sales content ecosystem (Google Drive, HighSpot, or similar platforms) to ensure materials are current, organized, and discoverable
  • Coordinate creation of sales collateral tailored to CPG buyer personas: pitch decks, ROI case studies, competitive battle cards, proposal templates, and messaging frameworks
  • Collaborate with Marketing to align value proposition messaging across channels, ensuring consistency in how TELUS CG's solutions are positioned to the North America CPG market
  • Manage CRM integrations with TELUS CG platforms and adjacent sales tools (marketing automation, customer success, product usage data) to streamline workflows and data flow
  • Support opportunity creation workflows, including automated opportunity-owner and opportunity-team assignment logic
  • Maintain a central contract repository and support contract-related data needs for sales and cross-functional teams
  • Partner with Customer Success on account health tracking, CS coverage models, and related reporting
  • Partner with Marketing Ops to define and execute BDR and business development campaign processes, including event follow-up administration and lead-routing transitions; troubleshoot lead-to-MQL scoring and conversion discrepancies
  • Relay sales team feedback and customer insights to Product and Marketing to inform go-to-market strategy and roadmap priorities

What you bring

  • 4+ years of experience in sales operations, sales strategy, sales management, or related operations roles in SaaS, CPG/retail tech, or B2B enterprise software environments (this background is essential to success in this role)
  • Expert-level Salesforce proficiency, including reporting, workflow automation, opportunity and account management, data administration, and CRM governance best practices
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for sales and executive stakeholders; proficiency with SQL, Python, or advanced spreadsheet tools
  • Demonstrated expertise in process design and ownership: you can take ambiguous, cross-functional problems and design end-to-end solutions with minimal direction
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present data-driven recommendations to sales leadership and executive audiences; strong documentation and dashboard design capabilities
  • Detail-oriented and proactive mindset: you anticipate needs, identify process improvements independently, and take ownership of problems without prompting
  • Ability to thrive in matrixed environments where you partner across Sales, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success teams

Great-to-haves

  • Experience with sales forecasting, quota setting, territory management, and compensation management in regional or multi-account enterprise sales structures
  • Familiarity with sales engagement platforms (Outreach, SalesLoft) and content management platforms (HighSpot, Seismic)
  • Understanding of SaaS business metrics (CAC, LTV, churn) and CPG/retail industry dynamics (trade spend, category management, retail execution)
  • Experience managing complex Salesforce renewal/auto-renewal workflows and sophisticated account/opportunity ownership models
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, or related field

At TELUS Agriculture and Consumer Goods, we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive environment where all individuals can thrive. We value the unique perspectives and experiences that each person brings to our team and invite you to join us on our journey of growth and learning. Together, we aim to create a respectful and welcoming global community.
